n-m-h1-mat-06.s.s3.model.0: Kwete, hazvisi kuti hapana. Semuenzaniso, kana B iri identity matrix E, saka AB=BA=A, saka kuchinjanisa kurongeka kunopa mhedzisiro imwe chete. Saka kurongeka kwekuwanza kunokosha mune dzimwe nyaya, uye unofanira kutanga watarisa kana unogona kuchinjanisa.
n-m-h1-mat-06.s.s3.model.1: Hadzisi nguva dzose dzakasiyana, uye pane nyaya apo dzakafanana. Maviri ari nguva dzakaenzana dzemumwe nemumwe, sa A ne 2A, anosangana ne AB=BA. Mune dzimwe nyaya kurongeka hakukoshi, asi kazhinji unofanira kutarisa.

n-m-h1-mat-07.title: Chii chinodikanwa kuti AB ne BA zvese ziverengeke?
n-m-h1-mat-07.topic: Mamatrix: mamiriro ekuti chibereko chitsanangurwe, nesaizi
n-m-h1-mat-07.goal: Tsvaga mamiriro anodikanwa kuti zvibereko zvese zviviri AB ne BA zvitsanangurwe, uye gadzira nyaya apo saizi dzaviri dzakasiyana zvokuti hadzigoni kunyange kuenzaniswa, kuti uzviparadzanise ne "kukosha kwakasiyana."
n-m-h1-mat-07.material: Matrix A ndi p×q matrix (mitsetse p, makoko q), uye B ndi r×s matrix. Chibereko XY chemamatrix maviri chinogona kuverengwa kana huwandu hwemakoko e X hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye Y chete, uye mhedzisiro imatrix yesaizi (huwandu hwemitsetse ye X)×(huwandu hwemakoko e Y). Kuongorora commutativity AB=BA, AB ne BA zvese zvinofanira kuvapo kutanga.
n-m-h1-mat-07.thinking.0: Kuparadzanisa mamiriro anodikanwa nemamiriro anokwana asi asingadikanwi
n-m-h1-mat-07.thinking.1: Kutanga watarisa mamiriro apo chirevo chinotsanangurwa
n-m-h1-mat-07.thinking.2: Kuparadzanisa nyaya dzisingagoni kuenzaniswa nenyaya dzakaenzaniswa uye dzakasiyana
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mamiriro ese anodikanwa chaizvo kuti AB ne BA zvese zviverengeke. (Sarudza anodikanwa chete.)
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kana A iri 2×3 uye B iri 3×2, wanza chaizvo kuona kana AB ne BA zvese zvingaverengwa.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora zvakasiyana mamiriro ekuti AB iverengeke nemamiriro ekuti BA iverengeke, uye uaenzanise.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.o.a: A ne B zvese ndi masikweya matrix, ane huwandu hwemitsetse hwakafanana nehwemakoko
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.r.a: Kana ari masikweya matrix, zvibereko zvinogona kuverengwa, asi uyu haisi mamiriro anodikanwa chaizvo. Kana A iri 2×3 uye B iri 3×2, hadzisi masikweya matrix, asi AB ne BA zvese zvinogona kuverengwa.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hwemakoko e A hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye B
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.o.c: Huwandu hwemitsetse ye A ne B hwakaenzana, uye huwandu hwemakoko e A ne B hwakaenzana
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.r.c: Mamiriro aya ndeokuti mamatrix maviri ane saizi imwe chete. Kana ane saizi imwe chete, huwandu hunogona kuverengwa, asi kuva nesaizi imwe chete hakureve kuti chibereko chega chega chinogona kuverengwa, uye haisi mamiriro anodikanwa chaizvo. Kunyange nesaizi dzakasiyana, 2×3 ne 3×2, AB ne BA zvese zvinogona kuverengwa.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.o.d: Huwandu hwemakoko e B hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye A
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.explain: AB inogona kuverengwa kana huwandu hwemakoko e A, q, hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye B, r, uye BA inogona kuverengwa kana huwandu hwemakoko e B, s, hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye A, p. Mamiriro maviri aya chete ndiwo anodikanwa; mamatrix haafaniri kuva masikweya kana nesaizi imwe chete.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga unyore seti tatu dzakasiyana (p, q, r, s) dzenhamba dzakazara kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 6 apo AB ne BA zvese zvinogona kuverengwa asi AB ne BA dzine saizi dzakasiyana.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro ekuti AB iverengeke nemamiriro ekuti BA iverengeke seequations, uye utaure saizi ye AB nesaizi ye BA nemashoko e p, q, r, s.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti mamiriro api anodikanwa pakati pe p ne q kuti saizi mbiri dzisiyane.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba ina dzese ndi nhamba dzakazara kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 6.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba ina dzese dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 6.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c2: AB haigoni kuverengwa. Huwandu hwemakoko e A nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye B zvakasiyana.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c3: BA haigoni kuverengwa. Huwandu hwemakoko e B nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye A zvakasiyana.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.ok.c4: AB ne BA dzine saizi dzakasiyana.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c4: AB ne BA dzine saizi imwe chete.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.explain: AB ine saizi p×s uye BA ine saizi r×q. Kana q=r ne s=p, saka AB ndi p×p uye BA ndi q×q, saka saizi dzavo dzakasiyana kana p≠q. Semuenzaniso, kana A iri 2×3 uye B iri 3×2, saka AB ndi 2×2 uye BA ndi 3×3.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.prompt: Kune A ne B dzakadaro (semuenzaniso, A iri 2×3 uye B iri 3×2), nyora kuti sei hatigoni kutaura AB=BA. Wobva wanyora mumutsara mumwe kuti izvi zvakasiyana sei nechirevo chokuti "pane muenzaniso we AB≠BA kumamatrix maviri ane AB ne BA dzine saizi imwe chete" (semuenzaniso, A=[[1,1],[0,1]], B=[[1,0],[1,1]]).
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwemasero (huwandu hwemitsetse × huwandu hwemakoko) we AB ne BA uye uvaenzanise.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinofanira kuenzana kuti mamatrix anzi akaenzana, uye uenzanise kuti chikamu chipi chemamiriro iwayo chinoputswa nenyaya mbiri.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakawana here saizi dzeAB ne BA?
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaparadzanisa here "hazvigoni kunyange kutariswa kuti zvakaenzana" ne "zvakatariswa, uye zvakawanikwa zvakasiyana"?
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.model.0: AB ndi 2×2 uye BA ndi 3×3, saka saizi dzavo dzakasiyana. Mamatrix esaizi dzakasiyana haagoni kunyange kuenzaniswa kuti akaenzana. Nyaya apo AB≠BA kumamatrix esaizi imwe chete ndiyo apo saizi dzakafanana asi kukosha kumasero kwakasiyana, saka chirevo chakasiyana.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.model.1: AB ne BA dzine saizi dzakasiyana, saka hatigoni kutaura kuti dzakaenzana. Izvi zvakasiyana nenyaya apo AB ne BA dzine saizi imwe chete asi zvikamu zvakasiyana. Munyaya yekupedzisira, dzinogona kuenzaniswa, asi kukosha kwakasiyana.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.model.2: AB ndi 2×2 uye BA ndi 3×3, saka saizi dzavo dzakasiyana uye hadzigoni kuenzaniswa. Mumuenzaniso we 2×2, saizi dzakafanana asi zvikamu zvakasiyana, saka kukosha kwakasiyana.

n-m-h1-mat-08.prereq.1: Mamiriro e ad−bc≠0 ekuti matrix ye2×2 ive neinverse
n-m-h1-mat-08.title: Kana inverse iripo, tinogona kugadzira chinangwa chipi zvacho here?
n-m-h1-mat-08.topic: Mamatrix: kududzira mhinduro yakawanikwa neinverse semamiriro enyika chaiyo
n-m-h1-mat-08.goal: Kunyangwe inverse iripo uye solution yakatarwa kuva imwe chete, inogona kusagutsa mamiriro eupenyu chaiwo (huwandu ari 0 kana kupfuura). Tarisa izvi nekugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa, uye utsanangure zvokwadi zviviri izvi zvakaparadzana.
n-m-h1-mat-08.material: Unoda kusanganisa marudzi maviri echikafu chemhuka, X ne Y, kuenzanisa huwandu hwe nutrient mbiri nechinangwa (p, q). 1 kg ye X ine 2 units ye nutrient 1 uye 1 unit ye nutrient 2, uye 1 kg ye Y ine 1 unit ye nutrient 1 uye 1 unit ye nutrient 2. Kana ukasanganisa x kg ye X ne y kg ye Y, huwandu hwema nutrient hunogutsa A(x, y)=(p, q) kune A=[[2,1],[1,1]], ndiko kuti, 2x+y=p, x+y=q. Matrix iyi A ine inverse nekuti ad−bc=2·1−1·1=1. Huwandu hwechikafu x, y hunofanira kuva 0 kana kupfuura (haugoni kusanganisa kg dzenegative).
n-m-h1-mat-08.thinking.0: Kuparadzanisa kuti solution iripo kubva pakuti inogona kushandiswa muupenyu chaiwo
n-m-h1-mat-08.prereq.0: Kunyora system ye linear equation se matrix
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi kubva pachokwadi chekuti A ine inverse.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza chinangwa chimwe (p, q), gadzirisa system 2x+y=p, x+y=q iwe pachako, uye utarise kuti x ne y dzinotora makosha api.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja p ne q uye uite kuverenga kumwe chete, wobva wazvienzanisa nema options.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.a: Kune chinangwa chega chega (p, q), equation ine ma solution akawanda (x, y)
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.r.a: Kana inverse iripo, solution yakatarwa kuva imwe chete. Kuva nema solution akawanda kunoitika kana pasina inverse.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.b: Kune chinangwa chega chega (p, q), equation ine solution imwe chete (x, y)
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.c: Kune chinangwa chine p ne q ari positive, x ne y dzinogara dzichibuda positive zvakare
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.r.c: Kuvapo kwe inverse kunoreva kuti solution iripo; hakusarudzi zviratidzo zve solution. Unogona kuzviona nekugadzirisa iwe pachako chinangwa senge p=1, q=3.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.d: Kune chinangwa chega chega (p, q), pane solution imwe chete ine x, y ari 0 kana kupfuura
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.r.d: Solution kutarwa kuva imwe chete kwakasiyana nekuti solution iri 0 kana kupfuura. Mamiriro eupenyu chaiwo x, y≥0 haavimbiswi ne inverse.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.explain: Sezvo A ine inverse, (x, y)=A⁻¹(p, q) inosarudza solution imwe chete kune chinangwa chega chega. Asi zviratidzo zve solution iyoyo zvinoenderana nechinangwa, saka kuva nesolution imwe chete kwakasiyana nekugona kuigadzira sechikafu.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise zvinangwa zvitatu zvakasiyana (p, q) apo p ne q zvose ari positive asi solution ye 2x+y=p, x+y=q inosanganisira nhamba negative.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga tsvaga ma expression e x ne y nenzira ye p ne q (kubvisa ma equation maviri kunoita kuti zvive nyore).
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora hukama pakati pehukuru hwe p ne q apo x iri negative, uye apo y iri negative.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Mu solution, x kana y ndeye negative.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Chinangwa ichi chine solution ine x, y ose ari 0 kana kupfuura, saka chinogona kugadzirwa sechikafu.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.explain: x=p−q, y=2q−p. Semuenzaniso, kune (p,q)=(1,3), x=−2 uye y=5, saka x ndeye negative. Kune (5,2), x=3 uye y=−1, saka y ndeye negative. (3,2) inogona kugadzirwa ne x=1, y=1, uye (4,2) ine x=2, y=0, saka inogona kugadzirwa nekusasanganisa Y.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.prompt: Chinangwa apo p ne q zvose ari positive asi solution ine nhamba negative chinofanira kutongwa "hachigoni kugadzirwa." Nyora chikonzero, uye uparadzanise zvinovimbiswa nezvisingavimbiswi nechokwadi chekuti inverse iripo munyaya iyi.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza muenzaniso mumwe apo solution ine nhamba negative, uye unyore nemashoko kuti nhamba negative iyoyo yaizoreva chii chaizvo mukusanganisa chikafu.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mumitsara miviri zvinovimbiswa ne inverse (kuvapo nekuva imwe chete kwe solution) nemamiriro anodiwa nedambudziko zvakaparadzana (x, y≥0).
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaparadzanisa here zvinovimbiswa ne inverse nemamiriro anodiwa nedambudziko zvakaparadzana?
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakadudzira here zvinoreva nhamba negative nemashoko ekusanganisa chikafu?
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.model.0: Sezvo inverse iripo, kune chinangwa chipi nechipi solution (x,y) ye equation yakatarwa kuva imwe chete. Asi kana solution iyoyo ine nhamba negative, haugoni kusanganisa kg dzenegative dzechikafu, saka haigoni kugadzirwa chaizvo. Inverse inovimbisa kuti solution iripo, asi haivimbisi mamiriro eupenyu chaiwo ekuti x, y ari 0 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.model.1: Nekuti A ine inverse, solution inogona kugara ichiwanikwa, asi kana x kana y ikabuda negative, zvinoreva kuti tinofanira kubvisa chikafu, izvo zvisingaite muupenyu chaiwo. Saka solution kuvapo nekugona kuigadzira chaizvo zvinhu zvakasiyana.

n-m-h1-mat-09.title: Inverse ye (A+B) ndiyo huwandu hwe inverse ye A ne inverse ye B here?
n-m-h1-mat-09.topic: Ma matrix: ma inverse nema sum, nemamiriro e muenzaniso unopikisa
n-m-h1-mat-09.goal: Ziva kuti kune muenzaniso unopikisa mativi ose maviri echirevo anofanira kutsanangurwa, gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa unosangana nemamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti nei muenzaniso unoshanda nechiitiko usiri proof.
n-m-h1-mat-09.material: Mudzidzi anoti, "Kune ma matrix maviri A ne B, (A+B)⁻¹ = A⁻¹ + B⁻¹ inogara ichishanda." Kuramba chirevo ichi tinoda muenzaniso unopikisa, uye kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa, mativi ose maviri echirevo anofanira kunzwisisika. (E ndiyo identity matrix [[1,0],[0,1]], O ndiyo zero matrix ine zvinyorwa zvose 0, uye [[a,b],[c,d]] ndiyo matrix ine mutsara wekutanga a, b nemutsara wechipiri c, d.)
n-m-h1-mat-09.thinking.0: Kutarisa kuti muenzaniso unopikisa unofanira kugutsa mamiriro echirevo (mativi ose maviri akatsanangurwa)
n-m-h1-mat-09.thinking.1: Kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa chaiwo nekutarisa mamiriro
n-m-h1-mat-09.thinking.2: Kuziva kuti kushanda mumuenzaniso mumwe hakusi proof
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mapeya ose (A, B) ari mienzaniso inopikisa inoramba chirevo.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, kutanga tarisa kuti A⁻¹, B⁻¹, ne (A+B)⁻¹ zvose zviripo here.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kune sarudzo dziri nema inverse matatu ose aripo chete, verenga mativi ose maviri zvakananga uye uenzanise.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.r.b: A+B ndiyo zero matrix, saka haina inverse. Divi rekuruboshwe rechirevo harina kutsanangurwa, saka mativi maviri haagoni kuenzaniswa, uye haisi muenzaniso unopikisa.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.r.d: B ndiyo zero matrix, saka B⁻¹ haipo. Divi rekurudyi rechirevo harina kutsanangurwa, saka haisi muenzaniso unopikisa.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.explain: Kune muenzaniso unopikisa, A, B, ne A+B zvose zvinofanira kuva ne inverse uye makosha maviri anofanira kusiyana. Sezvo E+E=2E, (2E)⁻¹=½E, asi E⁻¹+E⁻¹=2E, saka dzakasiyana. Inverse ye diag(1,2)+E=diag(2,3) ndi diag(½,⅓), asi A⁻¹+E=diag(2,3/2), saka dzakasiyana. Kune rimwe divi, ne A=E, B=−E tinowana A+B=O, uye ne A=E, B=O, B⁻¹ haipo, saka haigoni kuenzaniswa.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa B se identity matrix E, uye utsvage nekuisa mienzaniso inopikisa mitatu yakasiyana A=[[a,b],[c,d]] ine zvinyorwa ze integer apo chirevo (A+E)⁻¹=A⁻¹+E chinokundikana.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kuti A ne A+E zvose zvive ne inverse, imwe neimwe inofanira kuva ne ad−bc isiri 0. Nyora mamiriro maviri se ma expression.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.hint.1: Edza ma matrix nyore senge A=E ne A=2E kutanga, wobva wachinja zvinyorwa zvishoma uye utarise mamiriro.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Kune A iyi, (A+E)⁻¹ ne A⁻¹+E zvinoenzana nechiitiko. Chirevo chakarurama mumuenzaniso uyu.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.explain: Kana A=E, ipapo (2E)⁻¹=½E, asi E⁻¹+E=2E, saka dzakasiyana. Kune A dzakawanda, chirevo chinokundikana seizvi. Asi A=[[0,−1],[1,−1]] yakasiyana. A⁻¹=[[−1,1],[−1,0]], inverse ye A+E=[[1,−1],[1,0]] ndi [[0,1],[−1,1]], uye A⁻¹+E=[[0,1],[−1,1]], saka makosha maviri akaenzana. [[1,0],[0,0]] haishande nekuti A haina inverse, uye −E haishande nekuti A+E ndiyo zero matrix.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.prompt: Muhanho yapfuura, A=[[0,−1],[1,−1]] haina kuratidza kuva muenzaniso unopikisa. Kune A iyi, tsvaga (A+E)⁻¹ ne A⁻¹+E uye uzviwenzanise. Wobva wasarudza uye unyore kuti chokwadi chekuti makosha maviri akaenzana mumuenzaniso uyu chinoratidza chirevo "(A+B)⁻¹=A⁻¹+B⁻¹" here.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.hint.0: Kutsvaga inverse ye A, kutanga tsvaga ad−bc, wobva waiwedzera [[d,−b],[−c,a]] ne 1/(ad−bc). A+E ndiyo matrix yaunowana nekuwedzera zvinyorwa kutanga.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.hint.1: Mushure mekuenzanisa mhedzisiro mbiri, enzanisawo nemhedzisiro ye A=E kubva muhanho yapfuura.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga ma inverse ose maviri iwe pachako here?
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaparadzanisa "inoshanda mumuenzaniso mumwe" kubva ku "inoshanda munyaya dzose" here?
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.model.0: A⁻¹=[[−1,1],[−1,0]], inverse ye A+E=[[1,−1],[1,0]] ndi [[0,1],[−1,1]], uye A⁻¹+E zvakare ndi [[0,1],[−1,1]], saka dzakaenzana. Asi muenzaniso mumwe kushanda hakureve kuti inoshanda kune A ne B dzose. Pane muenzaniso unopikisa senge A=E, B=E, saka chirevo hachina kururama.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.model.1: Makosha ose maviri akabuda akaenzana ne [[0,1],[−1,1]]. Asi izvi zvakaenzana nechiitiko chete kune A yakakosha iyi, uye pane nyaya senge A=E apo dzinobuda dzakasiyana, saka muenzaniso uyu mumwe hauzogoni kuratidza chirevo.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.model.2: Makosha ose maviri anoenzana ne [[0,1],[−1,1]]. Asi muenzaniso mumwe kuva wakarurama hakureve kuti unogara uchishanda, uye kana pane kunyangwe muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa, chirevo hachina kururama.

n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva zvino chete.
n-m-h1-eq-05.title: Kana complex number iri 0, tinogona kutaura kuti real part neimaginary part zvose ndi0 here?
n-m-h1-eq-05.topic: Kuenzana kwema complex number: mamiriro apo real ne imaginary part zvinogona kuenzanisirwa zvakaparadzana
n-m-h1-eq-05.goal: Nzwisisa, nekugadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo ruchikura, kuti usati washandisa mamiriro ekuenzana kwema complex number unofanira kutanga watarisa kuti mavara ndenhamba dzerudzi rupi, uye gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa iwe pachako.
n-m-h1-eq-05.material: Pane expression (a−2)+(b+1)i=0. Tinoda kutsvaga a ne b kubva pa expression iyi. Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe.
n-m-h1-eq-05.thinking.0: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako kana ruzivo rutsva rwunoonekwa
n-m-h1-eq-05.thinking.2: Gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa uye uutarise nekutsiva
n-m-h1-eq-05.prereq.0: Zvinoreva complex number a+bi (a, b ndedze real)
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwunoonekwa, tarisa kuti mutemo wawakashandisa kare uchiri kushanda pasi peruzivo irworwo here.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.hint.1: Isa makosha mu expression zvakananga uye uyedze kuti a=2, b=−1 zvinofanira chaizvo kuva zvakadaro here.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Expression (a−2)+(b+1)i=0 yakapiwa. Hazvisati zvazivikanwa kuti a ne b ndenhamba dzerudzi rupi.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unogona kutaura chii nezve a ne b?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Vadzidzi vakawanda vanofunga kuti a ne b ndedze real uye vanoshandisa mutemo pakarepo. Asi dambudziko harina kutaura kuti a ne b ndenhamba dzerudzi rupi.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakashandisa pakarepo mutemo wekuti kana complex number iri 0, real part neimaginary part zvose ndi0. Ndiko kutonga kunouya kutanga.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hazvigoni kusarudzwa zvino: tinofanira kutanga taziva kuti a ne b ndenhamba dzerudzi rupi
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaona kuti kuti ushandise mutemo, unofanira kutanga watarisa kuti mavara ndenhamba dzerudzi rupi.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: a=2 uye b inogona kuva nhamba ipi neipi
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakafunga kuti b haina basa kunyangwe b iri mu expression. Tarisa zvakare basa re b+1.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.info: a ne b zvose ndedze real.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino unogona kutaura chii nezve a ne b?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Kune real number x, y, kana x+yi=0 ipapo x=0 uye y=0. Izvi ndezvekuti real number x ne y dzinogona kuparadzaniswa ne i. Saka a=2, b=−1.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Pane ma solution mamwe kunze kwe a=2, b=−1
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sezvo (a−2) ne (b+1) ari real, nhamba dziri pamberi pe i hadzisanganiswi. Edza zvakananga kuti pane ma solution mamwe here.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kuisa a=2, b=−1 kunopa (0)+(0)i=0, saka expression inoshanda.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Kuisa a=2−i, b=0 kunopa (2−i−2)+(0+1)i=−i+i=0. Expression inoshanda. (Pano a haisi real.)
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mu (a−2)+(b+1)i=0, pasi pemamiriro api tinogona kuita mhedziso a=2, b=−1?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Sezvo ma integer ari real, sarudzo c haina kururamawo. Asi mamiriro anodiwa nemutemo uyu ndeekuti a ne b ndedze real. Kana usingatarisi kuti mavara ndenhamba dzerudzi rupi, haugoni kushandisa mutemo.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mumuenzaniso a=2−i, b=0, a haisi 2. Pane humbowo hwekuti hazvisi "nguva dzose".
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kana a ne b dziri real
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kana a ne b dziri integers
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga unoda kushandisa mutemo nekukurumidza, asi pasina ruzivo rwekuti mabhii ari real, mhedziso inogona kuchinja. Mutemo wekuenzana kwecomplex numbers unoshandiswa chete kana "real part ne imaginary part dziri real".
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira a ne b dzinogutsa (a−2)+(b+1)i=0 apo a isiri real, uye unyore kuverenga kunoratidza kuti kuisa mumutauro kunopa 0.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa kukosha kuri nyore kune b, verenga kuti (b+1)i i chii, wobva wadzokera shure kuwana a inodzima.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isa a ne b dzawakawana mumutauro wekutanga uye utarise kuti kuverenga kunopa 0 uye kuti a haisi real.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga wasarudza b wobva wadzokera shure kuwana a here?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaongorora kuti a haisi real here?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.model.0: Kana b=0, saka (a−2)+i=0, saka tora a=2−i. Kuongorora: (2−i−2)+(0+1)i=−i+i=0, uye a=2−i haisi real.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.model.1: Isa b=i. Saka (b+1)i=(i+1)i=−1+i. Saka kutora a=3−i kunopa (3−i−2)+(−1+i)=0, uye a haisi real.

n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva zvino chete.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.title: Mhinduro yeSystem yeInequalities: Chii Chinochinja Kana a Ichichinja?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.goal: Kune system yeinequalities ine ibhii a, fungidzira uye gadzirisa kuti chimiro cheseti yemhinduro chinochinja sei nekukosha kwe a, uye utonge kana makoshero emuganhu akasanganisirwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.material: Tarisa mhinduro yesystem x² − x − 6 ≥ 0, x < a zvichienderana nekukosha kwe a. Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.thinking.0: Kuisa maseti emhinduro pamusoro penumber line
n-m-h1-ineq-04.thinking.1: Kusarudza kana kukosha kwemuganhu kwakasanganisirwa (chiratidzo chekuenzana)
n-m-h1-ineq-04.prereq.1: Mhinduro yesystem yeinequalities ndicho chikamu chakafanana
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wadhirowa mhinduro yeinequality yekutanga panumber line, wobva waisa x<a pamusoro payo.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda, tanga wanyatsotarisa kana kukosha kwemuganhu kune chiratidzo chekuenzana.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Pane system { x² − x − 6 ≥ 0 , x < a }. Kufactor inequality yekutanga kunopa (x+2)(x−3) ≥ 0, uye mhinduro yayo i x ≤ −2 kana x ≥ 3. Kukosha kwe a hakusati kwaziva.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kunyange a ichiva nhamba ipi, system iyi ine mhinduro here?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.after: x<a izvo zvose kuruboshwe rwe a panumber line, uye inogara iine nhamba dzakaderera kupfuura −2, saka pane mhinduro kune a ipi zvayo. Asi chimiro cheseti yemhinduro chinogona kuchinja ne a.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Pane mhinduro kune a ipi zvayo: x<a inogara iine nhamba dzakaderera kupfuura −2
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kana a ≤ −2 hapana mhinduro: haiyambukirani nemhinduro yeinequality yekutanga
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kana a i−2 kana pazasi, x yega yega ine x<a idiki kupfuura −2 uye inogutsa inequality yekutanga. Kunzwa kuti hadziyambukirani kwaiva kutonga kwakaitwa pasina kudhirowa panumber line.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kana a ≤ 3 hapana mhinduro: haiyambukirani nechikamu x ≥ 3
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kunyange isingayambukirane nechikamu x ≥ 3, inoyambukirana nechikamu x ≤ −2. Wakatarisa chidimbu chimwe chete cheseti yemhinduro.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Chikamu chakafanana che x<−2 ne (x ≤ −2 kana x ≥ 3) i x<−2. Pa−2, inequality yechipiri haishande.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Inequality yekutanga inobvumira x=−2, asi inequality yechipiri x<−2 haibvumire −2. Mamiriro ose maviri anofanira kugutswa.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Nhamba yakaderera kupfuura −2, seye x=−3, inogutsa maequalities ose maviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Sezvo x<3, hapana chikamu che x ≥ 3 chinogona kupinda, uye seti yemhinduro i x ≤ −2. Kana chiratidzo cheinequality chisina chiratidzo chekuenzana, kukosha kwemuganhu kunosiiwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: x=3 inogutsa inequality yekutanga asi haigutsi inequality yechipiri x<3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: x=0 inogutsa x<3, asi inequality yekutanga (x+2)(x−3) = −6 ≥ 0 ichienhema.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.3.after: Nokuda kwe "≥" muinequality yekutanga, 3 inosanganisirwa, uye nokuda kwe "<" muinequality yechipiri, 5 inosiiwa. Kana a ichikura kupfuura 3, seti yemhinduro inopatsanurwa kuita zvidimbu zviviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.3.r.a: x=3 iri mumhinduro nokuti inequality yekutanga ine chiratidzo chekuenzana. Wakasiya kukosha kwemuganhu 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Inequality yechipiri i x<5, saka x=5 haigoni kusanganisirwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.reflect: Kana a ichichinja, seti yemhinduro inogona kuva interval imwe chete kana kuva zvidimbu zviviri. Kuti kukosha kwemuganhu kwakasanganisirwa here kunoenderana nekuti chiratidzo cheinequality chine chiratidzo chekuenzana here, uye kana migumo yemainequalities maviri ichisangana papoinzi rimwe, "<" kudivi rimwe kunogona kusiya poinzi.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza makoshero ose e a ari pazasi apo seti yemhinduro iri interval imwe chete yakabatana panumber line, pasina kuputsika.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kune a imwe neimwe, dhirowa x<a panumber line uye ushade chikamu chinoyambukirana nemhinduro yeinequality yekutanga.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza zvikamu zvinoyambukirana kana a iri pakati pe−2 ne3 nekana a ichikura kupfuura 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.r.a: Kana a=7, saka x ≤ −2 kana 3 ≤ x < 7, izvo zvidimbu zviviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.r.c: Kana a=3.5, saka x ≤ −2 kana 3 ≤ x < 3.5, saka chidimbu chimwe pfupi chakasara uye i zvidimbu zviviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.explain: Kana a=−2, mhinduro i x<−2, uye kana a=1, i x ≤ −2, imwe neimwe interval imwe chete. Kana a ichikura kupfuura 3, 3 ≤ x < a inoonekwa uye inova zvidimbu zviviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuti nei x=3 isingagone kuva mhinduro kana a=3. Nyorawo kuti seti yemhinduro inochinja sei kana a ichikura kupfuura 3 kunyange zvishoma.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isa x=3 muinequality imwe neimwe yemaviri uye utarise iyo isingashande.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isa nhamba dzakakura zvishoma kupfuura 3, seye a=3.1 kana 3.01, uye utarise kuti nhamba dzipi padhuze ne3 dzinopinda nyowani.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaisa x=3 muinequality yekutanga neyechipiri zvakasiyana here?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unogona kunyora, seinequality, interval inoonekwa nyowani kana a yakakura kupfuura 3 here?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.model.0: x=3 inogutsa inequality yekutanga (x+2)(x−3)≥0, asi haigutsi inequality yechipiri x<3 (nokuti hapana chiratidzo chekuenzana). Kana a yakakura kupfuura 3 kunyange zvishoma, 3≤x<a inosara, iri chidimbu chakaparadzaniswa ne x≤−2, zvichiita zvidimbu zviviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana a=3, saka x<3, asi 3 haisi diki kupfuura 3, saka haishande. Kana a i3.1, nhamba kubva ku3 kusvika asi pasina 3.1 dzinopinda mumhinduro, saka mhinduro inopatsanurwa kuita ma interval maviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.model.2: Kuisa 3 muinequality yechipiri x<3 kunopa 3<3, iri nhema, saka 3 inosiiwa mumhinduro. Kana a>3, saka 3≤x<a inowedzerwa uye seti yemhinduro inoputswa kuita zvidimbu.

n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva zvino chete.
n-m-h1-logic-03.title: Kana Ma Intersection Akaenzana Kana Ma Union Akaenzana, Ma Seti Maviri Akaenzana Here?
n-m-h1-logic-03.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mumabasa eseti haugoni "kudzima" seti imwe chete sezvaunogona mukuwanza kwenhamba, uye usarudze kuti ndeapi mamiriro anodikanwa kuti utaure B=C.
n-m-h1-logic-03.material: Kune subsets nhatu A, B, C dzeseti yose U, tinoda kuziva kana B ne C dziri seti imwe chete. Ruzivo rwatinoziva runoratidzwa chimwe pachimwe.
n-m-h1-logic-03.thinking.0: Kushandura kutonga kwako pese painopiwa ruzivo rutsva
n-m-h1-logic-03.thinking.1: Kugadzira muenzaniso une B≠C unosangana nemamiriro
n-m-h1-logic-03.thinking.2: Kufunga zvakasiyana nezviri mukati meA nezviri kunze kweA
n-m-h1-logic-03.prereq.1: Zvinoreva ma seti maviri kuva akaenzana (zvikamu zvese zvakafanana)
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kana mamiriro anozivikanwa zvino achitaura pamusoro pezvikamu zviri mukati meA kana zvikamu zviri kunze kweA.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira muenzaniso mudiki weseti apo B ne C dzakasiyana asi mamiriro anozivikanwa anoshanda.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unogona kupedza B=C kubva paruzivo urwu oga here?
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Semuenzaniso, kana A={1,2}, B={2,3}, C={2,4}, saka A∩B=A∩C={2} asi B≠C. Intersection inotarisa zvikamu zviri mukati meA chete, saka hatigoni kuziva kana B ne C dzakasiyana kunze kweA.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Hongu: ma intersection ane A imwe chete akaenzana, saka B ne C dzakaenzanawo
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatakura chokwadi chokuti ma intersection akaenzana zvakananga kuti B yose yakaenzana.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hongu: sekudzima chibereko chenhamba, kubvisa A kumativi ese maviri kunopa B=C
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafunga kuti unogona kudzima sekuwanza nhamba. Kuti izvo zvinoshanda here kuma intersection eseti kunofanira kutariswa.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kwete: B ne C dzine zvikamu zvakasiyana kunze kweA dzinogona kuva nema intersection akaenzana neA
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakafunga nezvechokwadi chokuti intersection inotarisa zvikamu zviri mukati meA chete.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Rega x∈B. Kana x iri yeA, saka x∈A∩B=A∩C, saka x∈C; kana x isiri yeA, saka kubva pa x∈A∪B=A∪C tinowana x∈C. Zvakapesana, kubva ku C tinowana B nenzira imwe chete, saka B=C.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hazvichagoni kuzivikanwa: mamiriro ese maviri ruzivo rune hukama neA chete
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hauna kubatanidza chokwadi chokuti mamiriro maviri anotaura nezviri mukati meA nezviri kunze kweA zvichiteverana.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: B=C: mamiriro eintersection anoita kuti mukati meA mufanane, uye mamiriro eunion anoita kuti kunze kweA kufanane
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: B≠C: kana ma union akaenzana, ma intersection anofanira kuva akasiyana
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti mamiriro eunion neintersection anopokana.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Mamiriro eintersection A∩B=A∩C akapfuudzwa zvisizvo. Zvakasimbiswa chaizvo ndi A∪B=A∪C chete.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana A={1}, B={2}, C={1,2}, saka A∪B=A∪C={1,2} asi B≠C. Muunion, kunyange chikamu chiri kare muA chikashaikwa muB, A inochizadza, saka union oga haigoni kuratidza kuti B ne C dzakaenzana.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kwete: kunyange ma union akaenzana, zvikamu zveB neC zviri mukati meA zvinogona kusiyana

n-m-h1-ineq-01.title: Gadziriso ye Minimum ye x + 4/x Yakakanganisa Kupi?
n-m-h1-ineq-01.goal: Mugadziriso yakawana minimum uchishandisa hukama pakati pe arithmetic ne geometric means, tsvaga mamiriro apo fomula isingagone kushandiswa, uye ugadzirise mhedziso nekuisa mitengo.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.material: Jiu akagadzirisa dambudziko "Wana minimum value ye x + 4/x kana x i real number isiri 0" sezvakaratidzwa pazasi. (4/x i nhamba 4 yakagovaniswa ne x.) Verenga gadziriso uye upindure mibvunzo.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.thinking.0: Kutarisa mamiriro ekushandisa fomula usati wayishandisa
n-m-h1-ineq-01.prereq.0: Kuziva hukama pakati pe arithmetic ne geometric means (a+b ≥ 2√(ab) kune a, b i positive)
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaJiu.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana mutsetse mumwe nemumwe unotevera zvakanaka kubva pamutsetse wakamberi pakarepo.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsetse unoshandisa fomula, nyora mamiriro apo fomula inoshanda uye uaenzanise nemamiriro e x akapiwa mudambudziko.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.line.0: Kuwana minimum ye x + 4/x, shandisa hukama pakati pe arithmetic ne geometric means.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.line.3: Kuenzana kunoitika kana x = 4/x, saka x = 2 kana x = −2.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 ndiwo mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama. a+b ≥ 2√(ab) inogona kushandiswa chete kana a ne b zvose zviri positive (kana 0 kana kupfuura), asi x i real number isiri 0, saka inogona kuva negative. Mitsetse 3 nepashure inotevera mutsetse 2.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mutengo we x uye uuise kuratidza kuti mhedziso yaJiu haina kururama, uye unyore kuti kune x dzipi chirevo che "kwete shoma kupfuura 4" chakarurama.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba shoma dzekuisa pa x, kusanganisira dzine zviratidzo zvakasiyana, uye uverenge x + 4/x zvakananga.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana mitengo yaunoverenga ichipokana nechirevo chaJiu, uye kuti x i rudzi rwenhamba rwupi.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaverenga x + 4/x zvakananga uye wakaratidza kuti inopa mutengo wakaderera pasi pe 4 here?
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura mamiriro e x apo fomula inoshanda here?
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.model.0: Kuisa x=−1 kunopa −1 + 4/(−1) = −5, iri pasi pe 4. Saka mhedziso yaJiu haina kururama. Fomula a+b ≥ 2√(ab) inogona kushandiswa chete kana a ne b i positive, saka minimum value 4 yakarurama chete kana x i positive.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.model.1: Jiu haana kutarisa mamiriro apo x i negative. Semuenzaniso, kana x = −2, ipapo −2 + (−2) = −4, iri pasi pe 4. Mhedziso yaJiu haina kururama, uye mutengo i 4 kana kupfuura chete kana x>0.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.model.2: Kuisa x = −4 kunopa −4 + 4/(−4) = −5. I shoma kupfuura 4, saka mhedziso yaJiu haina kururama, uye minimum value i 4 kune x i positive chete.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza chirevo chakarurama nezve mutengo we x + 4/x kana x i negative.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga mitengo mishoma kune x i negative uye uinyore mutebhura.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kana unogona kushandisa chokwadi chekuti −x i positive kune x i negative kushandura kuita mhedzisiro yenhamba dzepositive.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.r.a: Wakashandisa mhedziso yaJiu kunhamba dzenegative sezvayakaita. Kuisa x=−1 kunopa −5.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakangochinja chiratidzo chemhedzisiro ye positive uye wakasiya direction yechiratidzo che inequality sezvayakaita. Kana inova negative, direction inochinjawo.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.o.d: Inogara i 4 kana pasi asi yakakura kupfuura −4
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.r.d: Wakafunga kuti mutengo unowira pakati pe −4 ne 4. Kuisa x=−1, −2, −4 kunopa −5, −4, −5, izvo zvisiri pakati.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.explain: Kana x<0, ipapo −x>0, saka (−x) + 4/(−x) ≥ 4, uye kuwanza ne −1 kunopa x + 4/x ≤ −4. Saka kana x>0 i 4 kana kupfuura, kana x<0 i −4 kana pasi, uye hapana mitengo iri pakati pe −4 ne 4 inoitika.

n-m-h1-ineq-02.title: Renji ye k Inoshanda Kune Real Numbers Dzose: Kuenzanisa Gadziriso Mbiri
n-m-h1-ineq-02.goal: Kuwana mamiriro e inequality kuti ishande kune real x yose, tonga kana mamiriro asiri quadratic anofanira kutarisiwa zvakaparadzana, uye utarise nekuisa mitengo.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.material:
Dambudziko: Wana renji ye real numbers k kuti inequality (k−1)x² − 2(k−1)x + 3 > 0 ishande kune real number x yose.

Hayun: Kuti quadratic inequality ishande kune real numbers dzose, coefficient k−1 ye x² inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 0, uye discriminant D/4 = (k−1)² − 3(k−1) = (k−1)(k−4) inofanira kuva shoma kupfuura 0. Saka 1<k<4.

Seojun: Hayun haana kutarisa mamiriro k=1 zvakaparadzana. Ndakaisa k=1 kutarisa, uye ndinofunga 1≤k<4.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.prereq.0: Mamiriro ekuti quadratic inequality ishande kune real numbers dzose (coefficient ye quadratic term ne discriminant)
n-m-h1-ineq-02.prereq.1: Kuita expression nyore nekuisa mutengo kuvara
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakarurama nezve mhinduro dzevadzidzi vaviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sezvakataurwa naSeojun, isa k=1 mu expression uye unyore kuti expression inochinja sei.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.hint.1: Isawo mitengo kunze kwe k=1 (semuenzaniso, 0, 2), uye uwane mitengo inoita kuti mhinduro mbiri dzisiyane.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.a: 1<k<4 yaHayun yakarurama. Sezvo i quadratic inequality, hapana chikonzero chekufunga nezve k=1.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.r.a: Wakagara wakafungidzira kuti expression ine squared term i quadratic. Hauna kutarisa kana mutengo uripo unoita coefficient i 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.b: 1≤k<4 yaSeojun yakarurama. Unofanira kuisa k=1, utarise, uye uisanganisire.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.c: Mhinduro dzevadzidzi vaviri i renji imwechete yakanyorwa nenzira dzakasiyana.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.r.c: 1<k<4 ne 1≤k<4 zvinosiyana mukuti k=1 yakasanganisirwa kana kwete, saka i marenji akasiyana.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.d: Zvose hazvina kururama. Mimwe mitengo ine k<1 inoshandawo.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.r.d: Kana k<1, coefficient ye x² i negative, saka expression inova negative kana x i hombe zvikuru. Wakatonga nemanzwiro pasina kuisa mitengo kutarisa.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.explain: Kana k=1, expression i 0·x² − 0·x + 3 = 3 > 0, saka inoshanda kune real x yose. Saka k=1 yakasanganisirwawo, uye Hayun akasiya mamiriro apo coefficient ye quadratic term i 0. Mhinduro i 1≤k<4.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mitengo yose inotevera ye k apo (k−1)x² − 2(k−1)x + 3 > 0 inoshanda kune real x yose.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isa k imwe neimwe uye uite nyore, wobva wawana x apo expression i diki zvikuru, kana uwane x imwe ine mutengo i negative kana 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kana mutengo wakati uchioneka sekupokana nemamiriro e discriminant, uuenzanise nemutengo waverenga zvakananga.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.r.a: Kana k=4, expression i 3x² − 6x + 3 = 3(x−1)², iyo i 0 pa x=1, saka haisi "> 0." Wakasanganisira mamiriro apo discriminant i 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.r.c: Kana k=0, expression i −x² + 2x + 3, iyo i −5 pa x=4, saka haishande.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.explain: Kana k=1 expression i 3, uye kana k=3 i 2x² − 4x + 3 = 2(x−1)² + 1 > 0, saka inoshanda. Kune k=0 mutengo i −5 pa x=4, uye kune k=4 i 0 pa x=1, saka haishande.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora nei k=1 inofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana. Nyorawo nei mamiriro e k<1 asingashande.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvinoitika ku x² term ne x term kana k=1.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti chiratidzo che coefficient ye x² i chii kana k<1, uye zvinoitika kumutengo we expression kana x i nhamba hombe zvikuru.

n-m-h1-ineq-05.title: Kutsanangurira Muridzi Wesitoro Mitengo Inoguta

n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.line.2: Saka, mukuru, kana ukagadza mutengo pa2 zviuru zvewon kana kupfuura uye 12 zviuru zvewon kana pazasi, uchawana purofiti.

n-m-h1-ineq-06.title: Kugadzira Quadratic Inequality Ine Poinzi Imwe Chete Yemhinduro
n-m-h1-ineq-06.goal: Ziva kuti seti yemhinduro inochinja sei nechiratidzo cheinequality kana quadratic expression iri perfect square, uye vaka quadratic inequality ine mhinduro iri poinzi imwe chete.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.material: Tinoda kugadzirisa quadratic inequality x² − 6x + 9 ≤ 0. Chikamu chequadratic chemutauro uyu chine chimiro chinofactor nyore.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.0: Kufungidzira seti yemhinduro kubva pachimiro chemutauro
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.1: Kuvaka mutauro unokodzera mamiriro iwe pachako
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.2: Kuchinja chiratidzo cheinequality uye kufananidza maseti emhinduro
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza seti yemhinduro yakarurama ye x² − 6x + 9 ≤ 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.hint.1: Funga range yemakoshero asquare angatora, uye uise x=3 ne x=0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.b: Ungangova wakashandura (x−3)² ≤ 0 kuita x−3 ≤ 0 nekubvisa square. Kuita square kunochinja zviratidzo, saka haugoni kuishandura nenzira iyoyo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.c: Iyo ndiyo mhinduro ye "≥ 0," kwete "≤ 0." Square inogara iri 0 kana kupfuura, asi nechiratidzo che inequality chakapesana zvakasiyana.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.d: Kuisa x=3 kunopa 0 ≤ 0, iyo inoshanda. Wakafunga kuti quadratic expression inogara iri positive, kana kuti hauna kutarisa zvakaparadzana nyaya apo discriminant iri 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.explain: x² − 6x + 9 = (x − 3)², uye square ndi0 kana kupfuura. Saka kuti (x−3)² ≤ 0 ishande, (x−3)² = 0, ndiko kuti, x = 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapeya matatu akasiyana e integer b, c akadai kuti solution ye x² + bx + c ≤ 0 ndi integer imwe chete ye positive. (|b| ≤ 40)
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cherechedza kuti b ne c zvaiva zvii mu expression yehanho 1, gadzira ma expression mashoma ane chimiro chakafanana, uye utarise kuti rimwe nerimwe riri mufomu (x−p)² here.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera (x−p)² uye unyore kuti b ne c zvinoratidzwa sei nenzira ye p, wobva wayedza makosha akasiyana e p.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.ok.c1: b ne c ndema integer ane |b| ≤ 40.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.fail.c1: b ne c zvinofanira kuva ma integer ane |b| ≤ 40.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Expression ine poinzi imwe chete se solution yayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Expression iyi haina poinzi imwe chete se solution yayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.explain: Kana x² + bx + c = (x − p)², ipapo b = −2p uye c = p². Kana p iri positive integer, solution ndi x = p chete. (b, c) = (−2, 1), (−4, 4), (−10, 25), zvichingodaro zvose zvinoshanda.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.prompt: Kune ma inequality matatu anowanikwa kubva ku x² − 6x + 9 nekushandura chiratidzo che inequality chete, ≥ 0, > 0, < 0, nyora solution set imwe neimwe, uye utsanangure mumutsara mumwe kuti nei izvi zvichiitika.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kutanga ronga kuti (x−3)² inogona kuva negative here uye kuti inoenzana ne0 kune x ipi.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa imwe neimwe yema inequality matatu nekuisa x=3 ne x=0, wobva wanyora ma solution set.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakasimbisa here kuti ma solution set e ma inequality matatu ose akasiyana?
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakapa here chikonzero chekuti square ndi0 kana kupfuura uye inoenzana ne0 pa x=3 chete?
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.0: (x−3)² inogara iri 0 kana kupfuura uye inoenzana ne0 pa x=3 chete. Kune ≥ 0 ndi ma real number ose, kune > 0 ndi ma real number ose kunze kwe x=3, uye kune < 0 hapana solution.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.1: ≥0: ma real number ose. >0: ma real number ose ane x≠3. <0: hapana solution (empty set). Izvi ndezvekuti square haigoni kuva negative uye ndi0 pa x=3 chete.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.2: < 0 haina solution, > 0 ndi nhamba dzose kunze kwe3, uye ≥ 0 ndi ma real number ose. Chikonzero ndechekuti (x−3)² ≥ 0, ine kuenzana pa x=3 chete.

n-m-h1-ineq-07.title: Kutarisa Mhinduro Yerenji ye x − y
n-m-h1-ineq-07.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa mumhinduro yakawana renji nekubvisa ma inequality maviri divi nedivi, uigadzirise nenzira yakarurama, uye uparadzanise kuti kuverenga divi nedivi kunobvumirwa rini kune huwandu, misiyano, nema product.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.material: Sumin akawana "renji ye x−y kana 1<x<3 ne2<y<5" seizvi pazasi.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.thinking.0: Kutarisa kuti mhedzisiro yemhinduro inonzwisisika here
n-m-h1-ineq-07.thinking.2: Kuparadzanisa kuverenga divi nedivi kunobvumirwa rini
n-m-h1-ineq-07.prereq.0: Maitiro ekutanga e ma inequality (kuwedzera mativi ose maviri nenhamba negative kunotsinhira chiratidzo che inequality)
n-m-h1-ineq-07.prereq.1: Maitiro ekuwedzera ma inequality divi nedivi
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaSumin.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kuti inequality yakawanikwa inonzwisisika here, uye utevere nzira inotungamira kwairi uchidzokera shure.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Isa makosha mashoma e x ne y anosangana nemamiriro, verenga x − y, uye uienzanise nemhedzisiro yemhinduro.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.0: Tsvaga renji ye x − y kana 1 < x < 3 …① ne 2 < y < 5 …②.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.1: Kubvisa ② kubva ku ① divi nedivi pamativi akafanana kunopa 1 − 2 < x − y < 3 − 5.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.3: Saka renji ye x − y ndi −1 < x − y < −2.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiwo mutsara wekutanga usina kururama. Ma inequality enzira imwe chete anogona kuwedzerwa divi nedivi asi haafaniri kubviswa. Kana y yakakura, x−y inova diki, saka magumo epamusoro 5 e y anofanira kuenda kumagumo epasi e x−y. Mitsara 3 ne4 inongotakura kuverenga kwemutsara 2.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.prompt: Nyora renji yakarurama ye x − y uye utsanangure kuti wakaiwana sei. Wobva waisa peya imwe yemakosha e x ne y anosangana nemamiriro uye utarise kuti mhedzisiro iri mukati merenji.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti ungatsvaga sei renji ye −y kutanga. Ungawedzera inequality ye y nenhamba ipi?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti x ne y dziri padhuze nemakosha api kana x−y iri diki zvikuru nekana iri huru zvikuru.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Sezvo ..., x−y yakakura kupfuura ... uye idiki kupfuura .... Tarisa: x=..., y=...
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura mumutsara mumwe kuti wakawana sei −4 ne1 here?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaisa makosha anosangana nemamiriro kutarisa kuti mhedzisiro iri mukati merenji here?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura here kuti nei kubvisa hakushande (kana y yakakura, x−y inova diki)?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.0: Kuwedzera divi rimwe nerimwe re ② ne −1 kunotsinhira zviratidzo zve inequality, kuchipa −5 < −y < −2. Kuiwedzera ku ① divi nedivi kunopa 1−5 < x−y < 3−2, ndiko kuti, −4 < x−y < 1. Tarisa: kana x=2, y=3, ipapo x−y=−1, iyo iri mukati merenji.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.1: x−y idiki zvikuru kana x iri diki uye y yakakura, saka iri padhuze ne1−5=−4, uye yakakura zvikuru kana x yakakura uye y idiki, saka iri padhuze ne3−2=1. Saka −4 < x−y < 1, uye kana x=1.5, y=4, ipapo ndi−2.5, iyo iri mukati merenji.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.2: Kutarisa x−y sa x + (−y), tsvaga renji ye −y, −5 < −y < −2, wobva wawedzera kuti uwane −4 < x−y < 1. Kuisa x=2.5, y=2.5 kunopa 0, iyo iri mukati merenji.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza nyaya dzose apo, kune a<x<b ne c<y<d, unogona kuverenga divi nedivi kuti utsvage renji.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, sarudza renji chaiyo yenhamba, verenga divi nedivi, uye uenzanise mhedzisiro nemakosha chaiwo.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.hint.1: Gadzira renji inosanganisira nhamba negative uye utarise kuti kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwe product kunobva papi.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.a: Renji ye xy kana marenji e x ne y ose ari positive
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.b: Kutsvaga renji ye x − y nekubvisa mativi akafanana divi nedivi
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.r.b: Kubvisa mativi akafanana divi nedivi kunogona kupa expression inopikisana senge −1<x−y<−2. Kune kubvisa, unofanira kupfuura neoperation inochinja chiratidzo.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.c: Kutsvaga renji ye x + y nekuwedzera mativi akafanana divi nedivi
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.d: Kutsvaga renji ye xy nekuwedzera divi nedivi pasinei nechiratidzo
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.r.d: Kana nhamba negative dzakasanganiswa, magumo e product anochinja. Semuenzaniso, kana −2<x<1 ne1<y<3, kuwedzera divi nedivi kunopa −2<xy<3, asi ne x=−1.9, y=2.9, xy≈−5.5 iri kunze kwayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.explain: Kuwedzera kunogara kuchigoneka, uye kuwedzera divi nedivi kunobvumirwa chete kana nhamba dzose dziri positive. Kune kubvisa uye kuwedzera ne zviratidzo zvakasanganiswa, unofanira kushandura zviratidzo kana kuparadzanisa nyaya uye kutarisa magumo.

n-m-h1-ineq-08.title: Tinoda Chii Chimwe Kuti Titare Huwandu Hwevadzidzi?

Kana tikapa ma pencil 7 mumwe nemumwe, vadzidzi vekutanga vose vanowana ma pencil 7 mumwe nemumwe, uye mudzidzi wekupedzisira anowana pencil 1 kana kupfuura asi kwete 7 zvizere.

n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.0: Pane ma pencil 4n+15 zvose. Mudzidzi wekupedzisira anowana ma pencil 4n+15−7(n−1)=22−3n, uye 1≤22−3n≤6. Ipapo 16/3≤n≤7, uye sezvo n inatural number, pane vadzidzi 6 kana 7.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.1: Kana huwandu hwevadzidzi ndi n, pane ma pencil 4n+15. Pane vadzidzi n−1 vanowana 7 mumwe nemumwe, saka chikamu chemudzidzi wekupedzisira ndi22−3n, uye sezvo ichi ndi1 kana kupfuura uye 6 zvakanyanya, n ndi6 kana 7.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.2: Sezvo 4n+15 − 7(n−1) iri 1 kana kupfuura uye 6 zvakanyanya, 22−3n iri pakati pe1 ne6. Sezvo n≤7 uye n≥5.33..., n=6 kana 7 inogoneka.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvikamu zveruzivo zvose zvinosarudza pakati pevadzidzi 6 nevadzidzi 7. (Funga ruzivo rwaunodzidza nyowani, kunze kwezvatotozivikanwa.)

n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.o.b: Chokwadi chekuti kupa 4 kumunhu mumwe nemumwe kunosiya 15
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.r.b: Ndiruzivo rwatovako mudambudziko. Vadzidzi 6 nevadzidzi 7 vose vanogutsa mamiriro aya.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.o.c: Chokwadi chekuti munhu wese kunze kwemudzidzi wekupedzisira anowana ma pencil 7
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.r.c: Ichi ichokwadi chatovako mudambudziko. Chinoshanda zvakaenzana kune vadzidzi 6 nevadzidzi 7, saka hachigoni kuzvaparadzanisa.

n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti ndeipi equation yaunowana kana ukaisa expression yechikamu chemudzidzi wekupedzisira nenzira ye n kuenzana ne4.

n-m-h1-ineq-09.title: |x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 3: Pane Solution Here? Marudzi Maviri Eumbowo
n-m-h1-ineq-09.goal: Enzanisa kutarisa kunoitwa nekuisa makosha mashoma neproof inotsanangurwa uchishandisa chinhambwe pa number line, uye ududzire solution set yakaitwa nehuwandu hwema absolute value nenzira yechinhambwe.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.material:
Vadzidzi vaviri vakapa umbowo nezve kuti inequality |x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 3 ine solution here.

Arin: Ndakaisa x = −1, 0, 1, 2, 3. Huwandu ndi4, 4, 4, 4, 4 nenzira yakarongeka. Hapana ari 3 kana pasi, saka hapana solution.

Dohyeon: |x+1| ichinhambwe pakati pe x ne −1 pa number line, uye |x−3| ichinhambwe pakati pe x ne 3. Chinhambwe pakati pe −1 ne 3 ndi4, saka chero x iri kupi, huwandu hwezvinhambwe zviviri hahugoni kuva hudiki kupfuura 4. Saka hapana solution.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.thinking.1: Kuverenga absolute value sechinhambwe pa number line
n-m-h1-ineq-09.thinking.2: Kududzira solution set yechiratidzo che inequality chakasiyana pa expression imwe chete
n-m-h1-ineq-09.prereq.0: Zvinoreva absolute value (chinhambwe pakati penhamba mbiri pa number line)
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakarurama nezveumbowo hwevadzidzi vaviri.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti makosha e x akaedzwa naArin ndenhamba dzerudzi rupi, uye kuti makosha asina kuedzwa asara mangani.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti tsananguro yaDohyeon inoshanda chero x iri kupi here, kana kuti inogona kushandiswa chete mushure mekuisa x imwe chete.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.a: Umbowo hwaArin chete hunosimbisa kuti hapana solution.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.a: Kuisa ma integer mashoma kungotarisa chete. Ma real number asingaperi asara asina kuedzwa.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.b: Umbowo hwose huviri hunosimbisa kuti hapana solution.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti kuisa makosha mashanu kunotsanangura x yese. Kune x iri kunze kwemakosha akatarisirwa, hatisati taziva.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.c: Umbowo hwaDohyeon chete hunosimbisa kuti hapana solution.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.d: Hapana pazvikamu zviviri zveumbowo chinosimbisa kuti hapana solution.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.d: Umbowo hwaDohyeon, hwakatsanangurwa nechinhambwe, hunoratidza kuti huwandu ndi4 kana kupfuura kune x yese, saka hunokwana.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.explain: Dohyeon akaratidza kuti, chero x iri kupi, huwandu hwezvinhambwe zviviri ndi4 kana kupfuura, chinhambwe pakati pe −1 ne 3. Iyi itsananguro ye real number x dzose. Makosha aArin akarurama, asi makosha mashanu oga haagoni kutiudza nezve x dzimwe.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.prompt: Tinoda kutsvaga solution set ye |x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 4 uchishandisa nzira yaDohyeon. Sarudza chakarurama.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Ratidza −1 ne3 pa number line, uye uenzanise kuti huwandu hwezvinhambwe zviviri ihwo here kana x iri pakati chaipo pemapoinzi maviri nekana x iri kurudyi rwe3.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.hint.1: Dudzira, sezvinhambwe pa number line, kuti nei huwandu mutafura yaArin hwose hwaiva hwakafanana.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.a: Pamagumo maviri, −1 ne3, huwandu hwunewo 4 chaizvo, saka vanogutsa "≤ 4." Wakarasikirwa nemuganhu wechiratidzo che inequality chinosanganisira kuenzana.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.c: Hazvisi pamagumo maviri chete apo huwandu hwuri 4. Sezvakaratidzwa mutafura yaArin, huwandu hwuri 4 kunhamba dziri pakati zvakare.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.d: Wakatakura mhedzisiro ye "≤ 3" kubva padambudziko rapfuura sezvayakaita. Kana pane x ine huwandu hwe4 chaizvo, ipapo "≤ 4" ine ma solution.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.explain: Kana x iri pakati pe −1 ne 3 (kusanganisira magumo ose maviri), huwandu hwezvinhambwe zviviri ndi4 chaizvo, chinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri. Kunze kwaizvozvo, hwakakura kupfuura 4. Saka solution set ndi −1 ≤ x ≤ 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuenzanisa kwekuti nei nzira yaArin (kuisa makosha) isingagoni kusimbisa "hapana solution," uye nei nzira yaDohyeon inogona.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa huwandu hwemakosha akatarisirwa naArin nehuwandu hwe real number dzose.

n-m-h1-geo-01.title: Kuongorora Chigadziriso Chedistance Pakati Pemitsetse Miviri Yakafanana
n-m-h1-geo-01.goal: Muchigadziriso chinoshandisa fomula yedistance pakati pemitsetse miviri yakafanana, tsvaga uye ugadzirise mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa, uye utarise uchishandisa distance kubva papoinzi kuenda kumutsetse.
n-m-h1-geo-01.material: Pazasi pane chigadziriso chaSeojin chedistance pakati pemitsetse x+2y−3=0 ne2x+4y+8=0. (Verenga x² se "x squared," √5 se "root 5," uye −3 se "negative 3.")
n-m-h1-geo-01.thinking.0: Kutsvaga mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa muchigadziriso
n-m-h1-geo-01.thinking.2: Kuongorora nenzira imwe (distance pakati papoinzi nemutsetse)
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga muchigadziriso chaSeojin unoenda kwakaipa.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kuti nhamba dziri pamberi pe x ne y dzii muequations mbiri dzinoonekwa mufomula yemutsara 2.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.hint.1: Edza mamiriro iwayo pamitsetse miviri yakanyorwa naSeojin, mumwe nenguva.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.0: Mitsetse miviri x+2y−3=0 ne2x+4y+8=0 ine slope imwe chete, saka yakafanana.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.1: Distance pakati pemitsetse yakafanana ax+by+c₁=0 ne ax+by+c₂=0 i |c₁−c₂|/√(a²+b²).
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.2: Kumutsetse wekutanga a=1, b=2, c₁=−3, uye kumutsetse wechipiri c₂=8.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.explain: Inoenda kwakaipa pamutsara 3. Fomula yemutsara 2 inogona kushandiswa chete kana macoefficients e x ne y muequations mbiri akafanana, asi mutsetse wechipiri une macoefficients 2 ne4 e x ne y, akasiyana nemutsetse wekutanga, uye 8 iconstant term yeequation iyoyo. Mutsara 4 kuverenga kunotevera mutsara 3, saka kukosha kwayo kwakaipa. Kupatsanura equation yechipiri ne2 kunopa x+2y+4=0, uye distance i|−3−4|/√5=7/√5.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa chikamu chakaipa uye uwane distance pakati pemitsetse miviri. Wobva wasarudzawo poinzi iri pamutsetse wekutanga, uverenge zvakasiyana distance yayo kumutsetse wechipiri, uye unyore kana uchiwana kukosha kwakafanana.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti ungachinja sei equation yechipiri kuti fomula ishandiswe.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza poinzi iri pamutsetse wekutanga uye unyore zvakasiyana fomula yedistance kubva papoinzi kuenda kumutsetse.

n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasarudza poinzi uye wakatarisa kuti kukosha kunobva panzira imwe kunoenzana nekwekutanga here?
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura kuti ndeapi mamiriro anofanira kuongororwa usati washandisa fomula here?

Kuongorora: distance kubva papoinzi (3,0) iri pamutsetse wekutanga kuenda ku2x+4y+8=0 i|6+8|/√20=14/(2√5)=7/√5, yakafanana.

n-m-h1-geo-03.title: Translate ne Reflect: Chii Chinoitika Kana Tikachinja Kutevedzana?
n-m-h1-geo-03.goal: Tarisa nemuenzaniso kuti kubatanidza translation ne reflection kunogona kupa mhedzisiro dzakasiyana kana kutevedzana kwachinjwa, uye utsvage nequation mamiriro apo kuchinja kutevedzana kunopa mhedzisiro imwe chete.
n-m-h1-geo-03.material: Poinzi P pacoordinate plane inofambiswa nezvichinjo zviviri. Transformation T itranslation ne m kunzira ye x ne n kunzira ye y, uye transformation S ireflection kupfuura x-axis. Uchafananidza "T wobva wa S" ne "S wobva waT."
n-m-h1-geo-03.thinking.1: Kushandura muenzaniso mumwe kuita equation yakajairika
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.prompt: Gadzirisa kufungidzira kwako nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda nezve zvinoitika kana kutevedzana kwachinjwa.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga waverenga nzira mbiri zvakasiyana uye unyore macoordinates epoinzi.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti chikamu chipi chetranslation chinobatana necoordinate ine chiratidzo chinochinja pasi pereflection.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Fungidzira translation (+1,+4) nereflection kupfuura x-axis zvakashandiswa kupoinzi P(3,2) munzira mbiri dzakasiyana, zvichipa mapoinzi maviri P₁ ne P₂.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti P₁ ne P₂ ipoinzi imwe chete here?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngativerengei zvakananga. Translation kutanga: (3,2)→(4,6)→(4,−6). Reflection kutanga: (3,2)→(3,−2)→(4,2). Mapoinzi maviri akasiyana.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Panguva ino, chinja translation kuita (+5,0). Poinzi ichiri P(3,2).
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mhedzisiro yenzira mbiri ichasiyanawo panguva ino here?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Translation kutanga: (3,2)→(8,2)→(8,−2). Reflection kutanga: (3,2)→(3,−2)→(8,−2). Panguva ino dzakafanana. Chakachinja ndechekuti huwandu hwekufamba kumusoro hwaiva 0.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Tinoda kutsvaga matranslations apo kuchinja kutevedzana kunopa mhedzisiro imwe chete. Vanosarudzwa i (2,3), (4,0), (0,5), (0,0).
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ndeipi pakati peaya inopa mhedzisiro imwe chete kupoinzi yega yega kana kutevedzana kwachinjwa?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Reflection kupfuura x-axis inochinja chiratidzo che y-coordinate, saka kufamba kunzira ye y kunofanira kuva 0. (4,0) ne (0,0) zvinogutsa izvi, uye (0,0) itranslation isingafambise chinhu.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.reflect: Kana ukafananidza kuti nei mhedzisiro dzakasiyana mumuenzaniso mumwe uye dzakafanana mune mumwe, unogona kuona kuti kutevedzana kwezvichinjo kunokosha here kunoenderana ne "chii chiri kufambiswa." Usati wasarudza "dzinogara dzakafanana/dzakasiyana" kubva pakuverenga kumwe kana kuviri, unofanira kuongorora nequation.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.prompt: Nyora seequations mhedzisiro dzekushandisa "T wobva wa S" ne "S wobva waT" kupoinzi (x,y), uye unyore mamiriro ane m ne n ekuti mhedzisiro mbiri dzienzane.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kune kutevedzana kwega kwega, nyora macoordinates epakati nhanho nenhanho.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza ma x-coordinates nema y-coordinates emapoinzi maviri ekupedzisira zvakasiyana.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso T wobva wa S inopa ..., S wobva waT inopa ..., kuti dzienzane ...
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora kuti y-coordinate inova mutauro upi munzira mbiri dzega dzega here?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasimbisa kuti kukosha kwe m hakukanganisi mamiriro here?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza mienzaniso yenhamba iri pamusoro neequations dzakajairika here?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.model.0: T wobva wa S: (x,y)→(x+m,y+n)→(x+m,−y−n). S wobva waT: (x,y)→(x,−y)→(x+m,−y+n). Kuti y-coordinates −y−n ne −y+n dzienzane, n inofanira kuva 0. m inogona kuva kukosha kupi zvako.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.model.1: Kana ukaita reflection kutanga unowana (x+m, n−y), uye kana ukaita translation kutanga unowana (x+m, −y−n). Kuti y-coordinates dzienzane, n=−n, saka chete kana n iri 0. Kana ukafamba mukati mekuruboshwe nekurudyi chete, kuchinja kutevedzana kunopa mhedzisiro imwe chete.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, fungidzira tinoshandisa reflection kupfuura y-axis panzvimbo ye S. Chii chinodiwa kuti translation (m,n) ne y-axis reflection zvipe mhedzisiro imwe chete kana kutevedzana kwachinjwa?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.hint.0: Panguva ino, tanga wasarudza kuti coordinate ipi inochinja chiratidzo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.hint.1: Fananidza macoordinates anobuda enzira mbiri nenzira imwe chete seyenhanho yapfuura.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.b: Wakatamisa mhedzisiro kubva kux-axis reflection kuenda kuy-axis reflection. Tarisa zvakare kuti coordinate ipi inochinja chiratidzo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.o.c: Dzinogara dzakafanana pasinei ne m ne n.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.c: Reflection inochinja chiratidzo checoordinate imwe, saka kufamba kunzira yecoordinate iyoyo kunokanganisa kutevedzana.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.d: Kufananidza hukuru hwemakoshero etranslation hakuna basa.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.explain: Y-axis reflection inochinja chiratidzo che x-coordinate. Translation ne (x+m, y+n) wobva wareflect inopa (−x−m, y+n), uye reflect wobva watranslate inopa (−x+m, y+n), saka dzakafanana chete kana m=0.

n-m-h1-geo-04.title: Kuongorora Chigadziriso Chepoinzi Yakareflect Kupfuura Mutsetse
n-m-h1-geo-04.goal: Muchigadziriso chekuwana reflection yepoinzi kupfuura mutsetse, tsvaga uye ugadzirise mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa, uye utonge kuti kuongorora kupi kunogona kubata mhinduro yakaipa.
n-m-h1-geo-04.material: Ichi chigadziriso chaDoyun chekuwana macoordinates epoinzi B, reflection yepoinzi A(5,0) kupfuura mutsetse y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.thinking.1: Kushandura zvakarurama mamiriro (midpoint, perpendicular) kuita equations
n-m-h1-geo-04.thinking.2: Kufananidza kana nzira yekuongorora ichibata kukanganisa
n-m-h1-geo-04.prereq.0: Product yemaslopes kana mitsetse miviri iri perpendicular
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa mumhinduro yaDoyun.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.hint.0: Rangarira kuti hukama hupi huripo pakati peslope dzemitsetse miviri yakamira pamakona akarurama.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.hint.1: Wanza slope iri mumutsetse 3 neslope yemutsetse y=2x uye utarise kana hukama uhwu huchishanda.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.1: Pakati ((5+p)/2, q/2) pechikamu AB iri pamutsetse y=2x, saka q/2=2·(5+p)/2, kureva, q=2p+10.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.2: Mutsetse AB wakamira pamakona akarurama nemutsetse y=2x, saka slope ye AB ndi −2.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.4: Kugadzirisa maequation maviri pamwe chete kunopa p=0, q=10, saka B(0,10).
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.explain: Inokanganisa pamutsetse 3. Kana mitsetse miviri yakamira pamakona akarurama, chibereko cheslope dzayo ndi −1, saka kuti chibereko neslope 2 ye y=2x chive −1, slope ye AB inofanira kuva −1/2. Haugoni kungoshandura chiratidzo. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 inotevera kubva pamutsetse 3.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsetse wakanganisa uye uwane ma coordinate epoindi yakaratidzirwa B. Nyorawo kuti ndeipi slope inofanira kushandiswa.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora slope yemutsetse y=2x uye utsvage nhamba inowanzwa nayo kupa −1.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.hint.1: Uchishandisa slope iyoyo, gadzira hukama hutsva pakati pe q ne p, uye ugadzirise pamwe chete neequation inobva pamamiriro epakati.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Sezvo vakamira pamakona akarurama, slope ye AB ndi ..., uye kugadzirisa pamwe chete kunopa ...
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here zvakarurama mamiriro ekumira pamakona akarurama sechibereko cheslope = −1?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti poindi yawakawana inosangana nemamiriro epakati nemamiriro ekumira pamakona akarurama?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura here kuti poindi yaDoyun (0,10) inoputsa mamiriro api?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.model.0: Kana vakamira pamakona akarurama, chibereko cheslope ndi −1, saka kune slope 2 ye y=2x, slope ye AB inofanira kuva −1/2. Kubva pa q/(p−5)=−1/2 tinowana p+2q=5, uye kugadzirisa pamwe chete ne q=2p+10 kunopa p=−3, q=4. Poindi yakaratidzirwa ndi (−3,4), uye pakati (1,2) iri pa y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.model.1: Kunyora slope se −2 kwakanganisa. Kana vakamira pamakona akarurama, chibereko ndi −1, saka slope ye AB ndi −1/2. Kugadzirisa nenzira iyoyo kunopa B(−3,4). Tarisa: pakati (1,2) iri pa y=2x, uye slope ye AB ndi 4/(−8)=−1/2.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.prompt: Kutarisa kupi kunoratidza kuti mhinduro yaDoyun (0,10) yakanganisa? (Poindi yaDoyun inosangana nemamiriro epakati akagadzirwa naDoyun.)
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.hint.0: Shandisa kutarisa kwega kwega zvakananga kupoindi yaDoyun (0,10) uone kana ichipfuura.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.hint.1: Taura kuti mamiriro api anotariswa nekutarisa kunotadza.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.a: Tarisa kana pakati pechikamu AB iri pamutsetse y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.a: Poindi yaDoyun yakavakirwa pamamiriro aya, saka kutarisa uku kunogara kuchipfuura. Unofanira kutarisa mamiriro akasiyana.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.b: Tarisa kana zvinhambwe kubva ku A nekubva ku B kuenda kumutsetse y=2x zvakaenzana.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.b: Kukosha uku kwakaenzana kumapoindi maviri, asi poindi yaDoyun inopfuurawo (zvese ndi 2√5). Unofanira kutarisa nzira yemutsetse AB zvakasiyana.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.c: Tarisa kana nzira yemutsetse AB yakamira pamakona akarurama nemutsetse y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.d: Tarisa kana B iri poindi yakasiyana na A.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.d: (0,10) ipoindi yakasiyana na A, saka kutarisa uku hakubvisi chinhu.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.explain: Kune (0,10), pakati (2.5,5) iri pa y=2x, uye zvinhambwe kubva ku A nekubva ku B kuenda kumutsetse zvese ndi 2√5, zvakaenzana, saka a ne b dzinopfuura. Asi direction vector ye AB, (−5,10), nenzira yemutsetse, (1,2), inopa (−5)·1+10·2=15≠0, saka hadzina kumira pamakona akarurama. Poindi yakaratidzirwa inofanira kusangana zvese "pakati ari pamutsetse" ne "mutsetse AB wakamira pamakona akarurama nemutsetse."

n-m-h1-geo-06.thinking.2: Kutonga nzvimbo inoenderana uchishandisa chinhambwe pakati pepakati nema radius

n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tsiva x=5/2 mune imwe yemaequation maviri epakutanga.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dhonza nzvimbo iri madenderedzwa maviri chaizvo, uchishandisa pakati pawo nema radius.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.a: Yakarurama. Mutsetse wakabva pakubvisa maequation, saka poindi dzekusangana dziri pamutsetse uyu.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakashaya kuti mutsetse unowanikwa nekubvisa chete "pakanga paizova poindi dzekusangana, kana madenderedzwa achisangana."
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.b: Yakarurama. Madenderedzwa maviri ane ma radius akaenzana, saka anogara achisangana.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange nema radius akaenzana, madenderedzwa haasangani kana pakati pawo iri kure.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.c: Haina kururama. Takawana mutsetse, asi kana madenderedzwa maviri achisangana chaizvo kunofanira kutariswa zvakasiyana.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.d: Haina kururama. Haufaniri kubvisa maequation emadenderedzwa maviri.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.d: Kubvisa maequation kuverenga kwakarurama. Dambudziko riri mukududzirwa kwemhedzisiro.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.explain: Kutsiva x=5/2 muequation yedenderedzwa kunopa y²=4−25/4<0, saka hapana y chaiyo. n-m-h1-logic-01.title: Kutsvaga Mutsara Wekutanga Usina Kururama Mumhinduro Uchishandisa Contrapositive
n-m-h1-logic-01.goal: Mumhinduro inowana contrapositive yemamiriro anobatanidzwa ne "uye," tsvaga nekugadzirisa mutsara wekutanga usina kururama, uye utsanangure kuti nei proposition yekutanga isingaiti yenhema kunyangwe contrapositive isina kururama iri yenhema.
n-m-h1-logic-01.material: Iyi ndiyo mhinduro yaMinseo, inoshandisa contrapositive kusarudza kuti proposition "[Kana x>0 uye y>0, ipapo xy>0]" ndeyechokwadi kana yenhema, kune real number x, y. (xy zvinoreva x nguva y.)
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.0: Kuteedzera mhinduro mutsara nemutsara kutsvaga painotanga kukanganisa
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.2: Kuigadzirisa kuva contrapositive yakarurama uye kutonga kana chirevo chepakutanga chiri chokwadi kana nhema
n-m-h1-logic-01.prereq.0: Contrapositive ~q→~p yechirevo p→q ine chokwadi chakafanana nechepakutanga
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa mumhinduro yaMinseo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa nenzira kuti mutsetse wega wega wakabva sei kumutsetse uri pamberi pawo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza imwe (x, y) apo p isingashande, uye utarise kana mamiriro akanyorwa se ~p mumhinduro anosanganisira kukosha uku.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.0: Rega p: x>0 uye y>0, uye q: xy>0. Ipapo chirevo chakapiwa ndi p→q.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka contrapositive ndi "Kana xy≤0, saka x≤0 uye y≤0."
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.4: Kana x=−1, y=2, saka xy=−2≤0 asi y≤0 hachisi chokwadi, saka contrapositive iyi ihunhema.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.5: Chirevo chepakutanga necontrapositive yacho zvine chokwadi chakafanana, saka chirevo chakapiwa chihunhemawo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.explain: Ndi mutsetse 3. Kana p ndi "x>0 uye y>0," saka p kusashanda zvinoreva kuti haisi nyaya yokuti zvese zviri zvakanaka, saka ndi "x≤0 kana y≤0." "x≤0 uye y≤0" mamiriro akatetepa zvikuru. Mutsetse 4 unotevera mutsetse 3, uye kuverenga mumutsetse 5 kwakarurama, asi mhedziso yomumutsetse 6 inotevera kanganiso yomumutsetse 3.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.prompt: Nyora contrapositive yakarurama, uye mumutsara mumwe kana miviri unyore kana chirevo chakapiwa chiri chokwadi kana nhema, nechikonzero chako.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti mamiriro maviri x>0, y>0 anofanira kutadza mangani kuti p ive nhema.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tsiva kukosha sa x=−1, y=2 mucontrapositive yako yakagadziriswa, uye uedze nhamba dzakanaka dzakati wandei muchirevo chepakutanga.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Pakunyora contrapositive, wakatarisa here nekukosha kuti sei "uye" ichishanduka kuva "kana"?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti sei chirevo chepakutanga chiri chokwadi uchishandisa chokwadi chokuti chibereko chenhamba dzakanaka chakanaka?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unonzwisisa here kuti sei chirevo chepakutanga chisiri nhema kunyange contrapositive isina kururama ihunhema?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.0: Contrapositive yakarurama ndi "Kana xy≤0, saka x≤0 kana y≤0." Kana x ne y zvese zvakanaka, chibereko chavo chakanakawo, saka chirevo chepakutanga chiri chokwadi.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.1: ~p ndi x≤0 kana y≤0, saka contrapositive ndi: kana xy≤0, saka x≤0 kana y≤0. Chibereko chenhamba mbiri dzakanaka chakanaka, saka chirevo chakapiwa chiri chokwadi.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.2: ~p zvinoreva kuti x kana y imwe chete iri 0 kana pasi, saka contrapositive yakarurama ndi "Kana xy≤0, saka x≤0 kana y≤0." Chibereko chenhamba mbiri dzakanaka chinogara chakanaka, saka chirevo chepakutanga chiri chokwadi.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.prompt: Kunyange mutsetse 5 wakaratidza kuti contrapositive yakanyorwa zvisizvo ihunhema, mhedziso yomumutsetse 6 yakanganisa. Sarudza chikonzero chinokodzera zvakanyanya.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga zvakare kuti chimiro chokuti "chine chokwadi chakafanana" chinoshanda pakati pezvirevo zviviri zvipi.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora chirevo chaMinseo necontrapositive yakarurama padivi pedzimwe uye uenzanise kana ichiri chirevo chimwe chete.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.a: Chirevo chaMinseo hachisi contrapositive, saka kuva nhema kwayo hakuendi kuchirevo chepakutanga
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.b: Kunyange contrapositive ihunhema, chirevo chepakutanga chinogona kuva chokwadi, saka haugoni kutonga chokwadi kana nhema uchishandisa contrapositive
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakatora contrapositive yakarurama nechirevo chakanyorwa zvisizvo seicho chimwe chete. Contrapositive yakarurama inogara iine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chepakutanga.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.c: Muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa haugoni kuratidza kuti chirevo chipi zvacho chihunhema, saka humbowo hwomumutsetse 5 hwakaneta
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakaderedza basa remuenzaniso unopikisa. Chirevo ichi chinova nhema nemuenzaniso mumwe unopikisa.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.d: Converse yechirevo chepakutanga inofanirawo kutariswa, saka contrapositive oga haigoni kupa mhedziso
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.d: Wakavhiringidza converse necontrapositive. Chokwadi chechirevo chepakutanga chinosarudzwa ne contrapositive oga.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.explain: Contrapositive yakarurama chete ndiyo ine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chepakutanga. Chirevo chaMinseo hachisi contrapositive, saka kunyange chiri nhema, hachitauri chinhu pamusoro pechirevo chepakutanga. Contrapositive yakarurama inogara iine chokwadi chakafanana nechepakutanga, saka unogona kutonga uchishandisa contrapositive (ndosaka b yakanganisa), uye muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa unokwana kuratidza kuti chirevo chechimiro chokuti "kune zvese ..." ihunhema (c). Converse inogona kuva nechokwadi chakasiyana nechepakutanga, saka hapana chikonzero chekuitarisa (d).

n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza hukama hweseti dzechokwadi hunoreva chinhu chimwe chete ne "p mamiriro anodikanwa e q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kubva pamutsara, tanga wawana kuti chii chinodiwa kuva chokwadi: "kana q, saka p" kana "kana p, saka q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tora chikamu cheseti imwe uye utevedze nzira yainofanira kuva muimwe seti, kune P ne Q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakaiverenga sehukama apo "kana p, saka q" ichokwadi, kureva, apo p iri mamiriro anokwana.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakaiverenga sehukama apo hapana kukosha kunosangana nemamiriro ese maviri. Mamiriro anodikanwa hukama hwekupinda.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakaiverenga sehukama apo mamiriro maviri akaenzana. Kuva anodikanwa hakureve kuti maviri anofanira kuenzana.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.explain: "p mamiriro anodikanwa e q" zvinoreva kuti kana q ichishanda, saka p inofanira kushanda, kureva, q⇒p. Chikamu chega chega cheQ chiri muP, saka Q⊂P. Kana P⊂Q, saka p mamiriro anokwana e q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.prompt: Nyora maviri matatu akasiyana enhamba dzakazara a, b (−10≤a, b≤10) kuti p ive mamiriro anodikanwa asi asingakwani kune q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dhonza Q=[−2, 4] sechikamu, uye usarudze kuti P=[a, b] inofanira kufukidza Q sei.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekusarudza a ne b, tsvaga nhamba chaiyo imwe inosangana ne p asi isiri q, kutarisa kuti iripo chaizvo.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b ndi nhamba dzakazara kubva pa −10 kusvika pa 10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara kubva pa −10 kusvika pa 10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c2: x yega yega inosangana ne q inosangana ne p zvakare (mamiriro anodikanwa).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Dzimwe x dzinosangana ne q hadzisangani ne p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Pane x inosangana ne p asi isiri q (saka haisi mamiriro anokwana).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c3: p ne q ndimamiriro akafanana, saka p inewo mamiriro anokwana.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.explain: P=[a, b] inofanira kuva ne Q=[−2, 4] pasina kuenzana nayo. Semuenzaniso, kune (−5, 6), P=[−5, 6], uye x=5 inosangana ne p asi isiri q. Kune (−2, 4), P=Q, saka p mamiriro anodikanwa nanokwana.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe yemaviri ako (a, b) uye unyore ① kukosha kumwe kwe x kunosangana ne p asi kusiri q, uye ② chikonzero chekuti x yega yega inosangana ne q inosangana ne p zvakare.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga wanyora chikamu [a, b] nemakosha ako e a ne b.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sarudza nhamba imwe iri muchikamu ichocho asi isiri muna [−2, 4].
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti x yawakasarudza iri chaizvo muna [a, b] asi isiri muna [−2, 4]?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here ② uchishandisa chokwadi chokuti magumo ese maviri eQ, −2 ne 4, ari mukati meP?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana (a, b)=(−5, 6), x=5 inosangana ne p nokuti −5≤x≤6, asi yakakura kupfuura 4, saka haisangani ne q. x yega yega ine −2≤x≤4 iri pakati pe −5 ne 6, saka inosangana ne p zvakare.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana ndikatora (−3, 4), saka x=−3 inosangana ne p asi isiri q. Huwandu hwe q, [−2, 4], hwuri mukati mazvo muna [−3, 4], saka pese painoshanda q, p inogara ichishanda.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.2: Kana a=-3 ne b=5, saka 5 inosangana ne p asi isiri q. Nhamba yega yega inosangana ne q iri pakati pe -3 ne 5, saka inosangana ne p zvakare.

n-m-h1-comb-04.title: Kuverenga ma divisors nekuita prime factorization nekugadzira nhamba ine ma divisors 12
n-m-h1-comb-04.topic: Product rule: kuverenga ma divisors ne prime factorization
n-m-h1-comb-04.goal: Ona ma divisors sekusarudza ma exponents uye uverenge ne product rule, wobva wagadzira nhamba dzine huwandu hwema divisors hwakapiwa uye utsanangure nei zvimiro zvinogoneka zvema exponents zvakaganhurirwa.
n-m-h1-comb-04.material: Fungidzira natural number N ine prime factorization N=2^a×3^b (a, b i integers dzine 1 kana kupfuura). Ma positive divisors e N ane chimiro 2^i×3^j ne 0≤i≤a, 0≤j≤b. Semuenzaniso, kana N=12=2²×3, ma divisors i 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, ari ma divisors 6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.0: Verenga nekushandura chinhu kuita chimiro (kusarudza ma exponents)
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.1: Tarisa nekugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inogutsa mamiriro
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti mamiriro erenji (exponent 1 kana kupfuura) anodzikisa sei mikana
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi expression ye a ne b inopa huwandu hwema positive divisors e N=2^a×3^b? (Tarisa nemamiriro e 12.)
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora ma divisors 6 ose e 12 muchimiro 2^i×3^j uye uverenge mapeya (i, j).
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana kusarudza i nekusarudza j zvinoitika pamwe chete kana zvakaparadzana.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.a: Kune 12, a=2 ne b=1, saka a×b=2, asi chaizvo kune ma divisors 6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.b: Kune 12, a=2 ne b=1, saka a+b=3, asi chaizvo kune ma divisors 6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.c: Kuisa kune 12 kunopa 3+2=5, asi chaizvo kune ma divisors 6. Funga kana kusarudza i ne j zvakaparadzana kunopa huwandu kana product.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.explain: Kune nzira a+1 dzekusarudza i (kubva ku 0 kusvika ku a) uye nzira b+1 dzekusarudza j, uye divisor inosarudzwa chete kana sarudzo mbiri dzaitwa pamwe chete, saka ne product rule kune ma divisors (a+1)(b+1). Kune 12 iyi i 3×2=6, izvo zvinoenderana.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.prompt: Wana mapeya 3 akasiyana (a, b) kuti N=2^a×3^b (a, b i integers dzine 1 kana kupfuura) ine ma positive divisors 12 chaizvo, uye uaise.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.hint.0: Govanisa 12 kuita product yenhamba mbiri kuti expression yehuwandu hwema divisors mu a ne b ienderane ne 12.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bvisa 1 kubva panhamba mbiri idzi kuti uwane a ne b, uye utarise kuti mitengo inoenderana nerenji iri mudambudziko.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b i integers dzine 1 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva integers dzine 1 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.explain: Kubva ku (a+1)(b+1)=12, tine 12=2×6=3×4=4×3=6×2, saka (a, b)=(1, 5), (2, 3), (3, 2), (5, 1). Ne 12=1×12 exponent imwe yaizova 0, izvo zvisingaenderane ne b≥1. Nhamba i 2×3^5=486, 4×27=108, 8×9=72, 32×3=96.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana N=2^a×3^b×5^c (a, b, c zvose i 1 kana kupfuura) ine ma positive divisors 12, (a+1)(b+1)(c+1)=12. Wana mitengo yose inogoneka ye a, b, c, uye unyore chikonzero chekuti hapana mamiriro anosiiwa.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mitengo diki zvikuru yakagona kutorwa ne a+1, b+1, c+1.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa product yemitengo diki iyoyo chete ne 12.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Paunonyora 12 seproduct, wakatanga wasarudza kuti nhamba dzingani dzinowanzwa here?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura nei factor ye 1 isingagone kushandiswa here?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo nezvemamiriro ane nhevedzano yakachinjwa (a, b, c munzvimbo dzakasiyana) here?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.model.0: a+1, b+1, c+1 zvose i integers dzine 2 kana kupfuura uye product yadzo i 12. Kunyora 12 seproduct yenhamba nhatu dzine 2 kana kupfuura kunopa 2×2×3 chete, saka (a, b, c) i 1, 1, 2 munhevedzano yakati: (1,1,2), (1,2,1), (2,1,1).
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.model.1: Exponent imwe neimwe i 1 kana kupfuura, saka (a+1), (b+1), (c+1) hadzigone kuva 1 uye i 2 kana kupfuura. Integers dzatatu chete dzine 2 kana kupfuura dzine product 12 i 2×2×3, saka ma exponents i 1, 1, 2, uye zvichienderana nekuti prime ipi inowana 2, kune nzira 3.

n-m-h1-comb-02.title: Kupenda zvikamu zvina zvegadheni remaruva nemavara matatu: tinogona kuvimba nekuwanza kwaHyunwoo here?

n-m-h1-comb-02.material: Gadheni remaruva resquare rakapatsanurwa kuita zvikamu zvina: A, B, C, ne D. n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s2.o.a: Kana uchipenda D, mavara ekudzivisa ndiwo mavara eC neA, uye huwandu hwemavara anowanikwa hunoenderana nekuti mavara maviri iwayo akafanana kana akasiyana, saka hatigoni kugara tichiwanza ne2.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s2.o.b: Kana pane mamiriro ekuti zvikamu zvevavakidzani zvinofanira kusiyana muvara, product rule haigoni kushandiswa mune imwe nyaya.
