n-m-h1-eq-01.title: Kukosha kwe √(−2)·√(−3): ndeipi pamhinduro mbiri yakarurama?
n-m-h1-eq-01.topic: Nhamba dzecomplex: kuwanza square roots dzenhamba dzisina kunaka nehuwandu apo mutemo weradical unoshanda
n-m-h1-eq-01.goal: Tarisa nekuverenga kukosha zvakananga kana mutemo wekuwanza wema radical maviri unogona kushandiswa sezvawakaita kana nhamba dziri pasi peradical dzisina kunaka, uye pfupisa mumutsara mumwe huwandu apo mutemo unoshanda.
n-m-h1-eq-01.material:
Seonu naHaeun mumwe nomumwe akawana kukosha kwe √(−2)·√(−3).
Seonu: √(−2)·√(−3)=√((−2)×(−3))=√6
Haeun: √(−2)=√2·i, √(−3)=√3·i, saka √(−2)·√(−3)=√2·i·√3·i=√6·i²=−√6
(Pano √ zvinoreva square root, uye tinobvumirana kuti square root yenhamba isina kunaka −k ndi √(−k)=√k·i.)
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.0: Enzanisa mitemo yatinovakirwa nayo mhinduro mbiri
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.1: Edza kana mutemo unoshanda nekushandura nhamba
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.2: Pfupisa nemazwi huwandu apo mutemo unoshanda
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa mhinduro mbiri uye usarudze kutonga kunokodzera zvakanyanya.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga kuti nhamba iri pasi peradical isina kunaka papi mumhinduro mbiri, uye uenzanise padivi pedzimwe kuti mhinduro imwe neimwe yakabata sei nhamba isina kunaka iyoyo.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Uchitevedza magariro anoshandura √(−2) kuva √2·i, verenga zvakananga kubva pakutanga kusvika pakupera uye usarudze kuti kukosha kunowirirana nemhinduro ipi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.a: Seonu: chibereko chema radical chinogona kubatanidzwa kuva chimwe, saka kukosha ndi √6
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.a: Yakafungidzira kuti √a·√b=√(ab) inoshanda kunyange kana nhamba dzisina kunaka dzakabatanidzwa. Tarisa shure kuti mutemo uyu wakagadzirwa kune nhamba dzerudzi rupi a ne b.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.b: Hazvigoni kusarudzwa: square root yenhamba isina kunaka haina kukosha kumwe chete
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.b: Musekondari magariro √(−k)=√k·i anosarudza kukosha. Verenga maererano nemagariro iwayo.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.c: Haeun: anotanga washandura kuva imaginary unit wobva wawanza, saka kukosha ndi −√6
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.d: Vese vakarurama: fomu chete ndiyo yakasiyana uye kukosha kwakafanana
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.d: √6 ne −√6 ndi nhamba dzakasiyana. Funga kuti chii chaizodikanwa kuti dzienzane.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.explain: Uchitevedza magariro √(−k)=√k·i, √(−2)·√(−3)=√2 i·√3 i=√6·i²=−√6. Mhinduro yaSeonu yakashandisa √a·√b=√(ab) sezvayakaita kunyange kana a ne b zvese zvisina kunaka, saka yakabuda √6.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza (a, b) dzese apo √a·√b=√(ab) inoshanda. (Verenga square roots dzenhamba dzisina kunaka se √(−k)=√k·i uye uenzanise mativi ese maviri zvakananga.)
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kune nyaya dzese ina, verenga divi rekuruboshwe √a·√b nedivi rekurudyi √(ab) zvakasiyana uye uzvinyore padivi pedzimwe patafura.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Paradzanisa nyaya apo kukosha kwakaverengwa kwakaenzana neapo kwakasiyana, uye utarise zviratidzo zve a ne b munyaya dzakasiyana.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.a: Verenga zvakananga kana mativi ese maviri akaenzana. Kana zvese zviri pasi pema radical zvakanaka, mutemo unoshanda.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.b: √(−4)=2i ne √9=3, saka chibereko ndi 6i, uye √(−36)=6i. Mutemo unoshanda kunyange kana imwe isina kunaka.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.c: √4=2 ne √(−9)=3i, saka chibereko ndi 6i, uye √(−36)=6i. Mutemo unoshanda kunyange kana imwe isina kunaka.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.d: √(−4)·√(−9)=2i·3i=−6, asi √36=6, saka kukosha kuviri kwakasiyana. Munyaya iyi mutemo haushande.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.explain: Kune a=4, b=9 unoshanda se 6=6, uye kune a=−4, b=9 nekune a=4, b=−9 unoshanda se 6i=6i mune zvese. Kana a=−4, b=−9 chete ndipo patinowana −6 ne 6, dzakasiyana.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti equation √a·√b=√(ab) inotadza kune nhamba dzipi a ne b, uye kuti √a·√b ne √(ab) zvinobatana sei ipapo.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rangarira nyaya imwe yakange isina kushanda mudanho rapfuura uye unyore zviratidzo zve a ne b.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kukosha kwekuruboshwe nekwekurudyi kunyaya iyoyo uye uenzanise kuti zvinobatana sei.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kana a ne b ari ... chete ndipo ... , uye ipapo ...
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here nyaya apo imwe chete pa a ne b isina kunaka?
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutaura here kuti kana zvese zvisina kunaka chiratidzo chinoshanduka nokuda kwe i²=−1?
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.model.0: Inotadza kana a ne b zvese zvisina kunaka chete. Ipapo √a·√b ine chiratidzo chakapesana ne √(ab), saka inova −√(ab).
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.model.1: Kana nhamba mbiri dzese dzisina kunaka, √a·√b=√|a|i·√|b|i=−√(ab), saka chiratidzo chakapesana. Inoshanda kana imwe chete isina kunaka kana zvese zvakanaka.

n-m-h1-eq-02.title: ω kusimba rechi 2026: kuverenga kwaChaerin kwakanganisa papi?
n-m-h1-eq-02.topic: Nhamba dzecomplex nema quadratic equations: masimba emudzi we imaginary nekudzokororwa
n-m-h1-eq-02.goal: Wana mutemo wemasimba kubva pa quadratic equation inosangana nemudzi we imaginary, tsvaga uye ugadzirise kanganiso mumhinduro yakashandisa nguva zvisizvo, uye utarise mutemo iwe pachako.
n-m-h1-eq-02.material: Chaerin akaedza kuwana kukosha kwe ω^2026 kana ω ari mudzi mumwe we imaginary we quadratic equation x²−x+1=0, uye akagadzirisa seizvi. (ω^2026 zvinoreva ω kusimba rechi 2026.)
n-m-h1-eq-02.thinking.2: Tsvaga mutemo we exponent anoita kuti power ive 1
n-m-h1-eq-02.prereq.0: Ma imaginary root e quadratic equation
n-m-h1-eq-02.prereq.1: Ma factoring formula nekuverenga ma exponent
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaChaerin.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mitsara yemhinduro nenzira yakarongeka uye utarise kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe unoshandisa mhedzisiro yemutsara wapfuura sezvayakaita here.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mhedzisiro yemutsara mumwe nemumwe nekukosha kwe ω³ kwakawanikwa mumutsara 1, uye uverenge nekuisa kukosha ikoko zvakananga.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.line.0: ω iroot ye x²−x+1=0, saka ω²−ω+1=0. Kuwedzera mativi ose maviri ne ω+1 kunopa ω³+1=0, saka ω³=−1.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.line.1: Kuparadzanisa 2026 ne3 kunopa quotient 675 ne remainder 1.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 4 hauna kururama. Mutsara 1 wakati ω³=−1, saka (ω³)^675=(−1)^675=−1. Saka ω^2026=−ω. Mitsara 1 kusvika ku3 yakarurama.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kukosha kwakagadziriswa kwe ω^2026, uye uratidze kuti imwe nzira (semuenzaniso, kushandisa kukosha kwe ω⁶ ne remainder kana uchiparadzanisa ne6) inopa kukosha kwakafanana.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.hint.0: Shandisa kukosha kwe ω³ sezvakawanikwa kare, uye usarudze chiratidzo chemhedzisiro yekuiwedzera nguva 675.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kana ω³=−1, tsvaga kukosha kwe ω⁶, wobva waverenga zvakare uchishandisa remainder kana 2026 yaparadzaniswa ne exponent iyoyo.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakasarudza chiratidzo che (−1)^675 nekuti exponent ndeye odd here?
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa nemhedzisiro yekuverenga uchishandisa remainder kana uchiparadzanisa ne6 here?
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.model.0: ω^2026=−ω. Sezvo ω³=−1, (ω³)^675=(−1)^675=−1. Nenzira imwe, ω⁶=1 uye 2026=6×337+4, saka ω^2026=ω⁴=ω³·ω=−ω, iyo yakafanana.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.model.1: (ω³)^675=(−1)^675 ndi−1 nekuti exponent ndeye odd. Saka ω^2026 ndi−ω. Izvi zvinowirirana nechokwadi chekuti remainder 4 kana uchiparadzanisa ne6 inopa ω⁴=−ω.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.prompt: Kune imaginary root ω ye x²−x+1=0, tsvaga uye uise natural number k tatu dzakasiyana (1≤k≤60) dzakadai kuti ω^k=1.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.hint.0: Wedzera exponent seka ω³, ω⁶, ω⁹ uye unyore makosha nenzira yakarongeka.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga exponent yekutanga apo kukosha kunova 1, wobva wayedza kuti zvakafanana here pama multiple e exponent iyoyo.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Inatural number kubva ku1 kusvika ku60.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Inofanira kuva natural number kubva ku1 kusvika ku60.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Kune k iyi, ω^k haienzani ne1. Verenga ω³, ω⁶, zvichingodaro nenzira yakarongeka.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.explain: Sezvo ω³=−1, ω⁶=1. Saka ω^k=1 kune k iri multiple ye6. Kune k=3, ω³=−1, saka haishande.

n-m-h1-eq-03.title: Kana root imwe iri 1+i, root imwe iri 1−i here?
n-m-h1-eq-03.topic: Ma imaginary root e quadratic equation: mamiriro anovimbisa conjugate root
n-m-h1-eq-03.goal: Tsvaga ruzivo rwunodiwa kusarudza root imwe kana imwe iri imaginary, uye gadzira muenzaniso apo mhedziso inochinja kana ruzivo urwu rusipo.
n-m-h1-eq-03.material: Ngatitii root imwe ye x²+px+q=0 ndi1+i. Soyeon akati, "Root imwe inofanira kuva 1−i," uye Jeonghun akati, "Haugoni kuzvisimbisa." (Hazvisati zvazivikanwa kuti p ne q ndenhamba dzipi.)
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.0: Tsvaga mamiriro akavanzika anodiwa kuti mhedziso ishande
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.1: Gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa iwe pachako uye uutarise
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti nei muenzaniso unopikisa unoratidza kuti mamiriro anodiwa
n-m-h1-eq-03.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pema root maviri nema coefficient e quadratic equation
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.prompt: Kuti chirevo chaSoyeon chishande zvakanyanya, ndeapi pazvinotevera akakwana kuziva?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ngatitii root imwe ndi a+bi uye nyora huwandu nema product ema root maviri nenzira yema a ne b zvakananga.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti mamiriro ari pasarudzo imwe neimwe anopa expression ipi ye a ne b, uye utsvage nyaya inogutsa asi a+bi isiri 1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.a: Kana usingazivi kuti p ne q ndedze real here, p²−4q inogona kuva complex number, saka shoko rekuti "negative" pacharo rinogona kusatsanangurwa.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hwema root maviri, −p, ndeye real
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.b: Kunyangwe huwandu huri real, root imwe inogona kusava 1−i. Ngatitii root imwe ndi a+bi uye utarise imaginary part yehuwandu.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.o.c: Product yema root maviri, q, ndeye real
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.c: Kunyangwe product iri real, root imwe inogona kusava 1−i. Ngatitii root imwe ndi a+bi uye utarise imaginary part ye product.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.o.d: Ma coefficient p ne q ose ndedze real
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.explain: Chete kana p ne q ose ari real ndiko conjugate complex number iri root. Kuva nehuwandu chete real, kana product chete real, hazvikwani. Kana zvose zviri real, ndiyo nyaya apo p ne q ari real, uye mhedziso yatarwa.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitii root imwe ndi a+bi (a, b ndema integer kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9). Isa mapeya matatu akasiyana (a, b) akadai kuti huwandu hwema root maviri ndeye real uye root imwe isiri 1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora real part ne imaginary part yehuwandu (1+i)+(a+bi) nenzira ye a ne b.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza kuti chikamu chipi chinofanira kuva 0 kuti huwandu hwuve real, uye uyedze nekushandura kukosha kwe a pasi pemamiriro iwayo.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.var.a: Real part a ye root imwe
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.var.b: Imaginary part b ye root imwe
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b ndema integer ari mu renji.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b zvinofanira kuva ma integer kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Imaginary part yehuwandu hwema root maviri ndi0, saka huwandu ndeye real.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu (1+a)+(1+b)i haisi real. Edza kuita kuti imaginary part yehuwandu ive 0.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Root imwe inobuda iri 1−i. Unofanira kutsvaga nyaya inosiyana nechirevo chaSoyeon.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.explain: Kuti huwandu hwuve real, imaginary part 1+b inofanira kuva 0, saka b=−1, uye kana a isiri 1, root imwe haisi 1−i. Semuenzaniso, kana ma root ari 1+i ne3−i, huwandu ndi4, iyo ndeye real, asi root imwe haisi 1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.prompt: Tarisa equation ine ma root 1+i ne3−i: huwandu ndeye real, asi chirevo chaSoyeon hachishande. Verengawo product yema root maviri, uye unyore kuti nei equation iyi iri muenzaniso unopikisa chirevo chaSoyeon.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.hint.0: Wedzera (1+i)(3−i) uchishandisa distributive law uye upfupise nekutsiva i² ne−1.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti p ne q zvinotarwa nehuwandu ne product yema root maviri, uye utarise kuti p ne q ndedze real here.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakawedzera (1+i)(3−i) zvakananga uye wakasimbisa kuti imaginary part inosara here?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti equation iri muenzaniso unopikisa inoputsa mamiriro anodiwa nechirevo chaSoyeon here?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.model.0: (1+i)(3−i)=3−i+3i−i²=4+2i, saka product haisi real. Sezvo product q isiri real, p ne q hazvisi zvose real, saka mamiriro anodiwa nechirevo chaSoyeon haana kugutswa.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.model.1: Huwandu ndi4, iyo ndeye real, asi product ndi4+2i, iyo ine imaginary part uye isiri real. Ma coefficient e equation iyi haasi ose real, saka pasina mamiriro ekuti ma coefficient ari real, hatigoni kutaura kuti root imwe ndi1−i.

n-m-h1-eq-04.title: Kugadzira equation x⁴+ax²+b=0 ine x=2 se root
n-m-h1-eq-04.topic: Ma equation e degree yakakwira: ma biquadratic equation nemamiriro e real root mushure mekutsiva
n-m-h1-eq-04.goal: Sarudza kuti ma root api e quadratic equation inowanikwa ne x²=t anopa real root dze equation yekutanga, gadzira ma equation akawanda anosangana nemamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti nei.
n-m-h1-eq-04.material: Pane equation x⁴+ax²+b=0 (a, b ndema integer). Pakati pema root ayo mana (verenga root inodzokororwa nemultiplicity), tinoda kuti maviri chete ave real uye mamwe maviri ave imaginary. Uyezve, x=2 iroot ye equation iyi.
n-m-h1-eq-04.thinking.1: Gadzira ma equation akawanda anosangana nemamiriro
n-m-h1-eq-04.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti nei chiratidzo che coefficient chinosarudza rudzi rwema root
n-m-h1-eq-04.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pema root nema coefficient e quadratic equation
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.prompt: Kuisa x²=t kunopa t²+at+b=0. Kuti x mu equation yekutanga ive real, t inofanira kutora makosha api?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzirisa x²=t kunyaya nhatu t=4, t=0, t=−4 uye utarise kuti x ndeye real here.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti renji yemakosha ipi yaunogara uchiwana kana ukaita square real number x.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.a: Ne x=√t, kunyangwe t iri integer, x haisi real kana t iri negative. Chinokosha chiratidzo, kwete kuti ndeye integer here.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.b: Zvakakwana kuti t ive real number
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.b: Kunyangwe t iri real, kana iri negative hapana x real ine x²=t. Edza kugadzirisa x²=−4 kune t=−4.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.c: t ireal number iri 0 kana kupfuura
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.d: Kunyangwe t iri 0, x=0 iroot ye real, uye kunyangwe t isiri integer, ma real root anowanikwa. Mamiriro akamanikana zvakanyanya.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.explain: Kana x iri real, x²=t ndi0 kana kupfuura. Zvakapesana, kana t iri real number ine 0 kana kupfuura, ipapo x=±√t ndedze real root. Kana t iri negative, x inova peya yema imaginary number ari ma conjugate emumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga mapeya matatu e integer akasiyana (a, b) e equation x⁴+ax²+b=0 akadai kuti x=2 iroot, maviri chete pa root ina ari real (2 ne−2), uye mamwe maviri ari imaginary. (−20≤a≤20)
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isa x=2 kuti uwane hukama humwe pakati pe a ne b, wobva wasarudza a, utsvage b, uye utsvage ma root maviri e t²+at+b=0 zvakananga.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rimwe rema root maviri e t ndi4. Tarisa kuti ma root e equation yekutanga anova chii kana rimwe root iri positive, 0, kana negative.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b zvinofanira kuva ma integer ane −20≤a≤20.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuisa x=2 hakupi 0. Tarisa kukosha kwe 16+4a+b.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Rimwe chete pama root maviri e t ndiro positive.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Hapana ma real root maviri (ose mana ari real, kana 0 iroot). Tarisa zviratidzo zvema root maviri e quadratic equation mu t.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.explain: Kana x=2, ipapo t=4 iroot ye t²+at+b=0, saka 16+4a+b=0. Imwe t ndi−a−4, uye kukosha uku kunofanira kuva negative, saka b=4(−a−4)<0. Semuenzaniso, (a, b)=(−3, −4) inopa (t−4)(t+1)=0, saka x=±2, ±i.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti product yema root maviri e quadratic equation mu t ndi b, tsanangura kuti nei, kana b<0, equation yekutanga ine ma real root maviri chaizvo.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ngatitii ma root maviri e t²+at+b=0 ndi t₁, t₂, nyora t₁t₂ se b, uye ufunge zviratidzo zvema root maviri kana b iri negative.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora kuti x inova chii kana ukagadzirisa x²=t kune t ye positive nekune t ye negative.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso. Sezvo product yema root maviri e t ndi b, ...
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakasimbisa here kuti iya ye positive pamakosha maviri e t inopa x=±√t?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakasimbisa here kuti x inova imaginary kune iya ye negative?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Product yema root maviri e t ndi b uye b<0, saka ma root maviri ane zviratidzo zvakapesana, rimwe positive rimwe negative. t ye positive inopa x=±√t, ma real root maviri, uye t ye negative inoita kuti x ive imaginary.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Nehukama pakati pema root nema coefficient, product yemakosha maviri e t ndi b, saka kana b iri negative, imwe t ndeye positive uye imwe ndeye negative. Chete t ye positive inopa x real uye t ye negative inopa ma imaginary root, saka pane ma real root maviri chaizvo.

n-m-h1-eq-08.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pema root nema coefficient e quadratic equation
n-m-h1-eq-08.title: Chigadziriso chinowana k kubva paproduct yemidzi mitatu: chiratidzo chakarurama here?
n-m-h1-eq-08.topic: Maequations ane degree yakakwirira: zviratidzo muhukama pakati pemidzi nemacoefficients ecubic equation
n-m-h1-eq-08.goal: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise mutsara wakaipa muhukama pakati pemidzi nemacoefficients ecubic equation, uye utarise chiratidzo chehukama hwakajairika uchishandisa equation ine midzi yakasarudzika.
n-m-h1-eq-08.material: Ichi chigadziriso chaHajun chekuwana kukosha kweconstant k kana midzi mitatu ye x³−2x²−5x+k=0 i α, β, γ uye product yemidzi mitatu αβγ i−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.thinking.2: Tarisa zviratidzo zvefomula yakajairika nemuenzaniso chaiwo
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga wakaipa muchigadziriso chaHajun.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti constant term inova chii kana ukatambanudza (x−α)(x−β)(x−γ).
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.hint.1: Fananidza kana chiratidzo checonstant term chakafanana kana chakapesana neproduct yemidzi mitatu.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.0: Rega midzi mitatu ye x³−2x²−5x+k=0 ive α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.1: Nehukama pakati pemidzi nemacoefficients, product yemidzi mitatu iconstant term k yakapatsanurwa neleading coefficient 1, saka αβγ=k.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.3: Saka kukosha kwe k kwatinoda i−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 wakaipa. Kune cubic equation, product yemidzi mitatu i−(constant term)÷(leading coefficient), saka αβγ=−k. Ipapo −k=−6 inopa k=6. Mitsara 3 ne4 kuverenga kunotevera mutsara 2.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kukosha kwakagadziriswa kwe k, uye unyore maitiro ekuongorora kuti product yemidzi mitatu i−6 chaizvo kune k iyoyo, nekufactor equation kana kuisa mudzi.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzirisa mutsara wakaipa uye uwane k zvakare, wobva wanyora equation ne k iyoyo uye uwane integer imwe iri mudzi.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wawana mudzi mumwe, factor kuti uwane mimwe midzi uye uwanze midzi mitatu.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kana k=6, wakafactor x³−2x²−5x+6 uye wakawana midzi mitatu here?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakawanza midzi mitatu zvakananga uye wakatarisa kuti unowana −6 here?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.0: αβγ=−k, saka −k=−6 inopa k=6. Kuongorora: x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), saka midzi mitatu i1, 3, −2 uye product i1×3×(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.1: Chiratidzo checonstant term chakapesana, saka product yemidzi mitatu i−k. Saka k=6, uye kuisa x=1 kunopa 1−2−5+6=0, saka imudzi. Kuinyora se (x−1)(x−3)(x+2), product yemidzi mitatu i1·3·(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.2: k=6. x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), saka midzi i1, 3, −2 uye product i−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza hukama hwakarurama kana midzi mitatu ye x³+ax²+bx+c=0 i α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora cubic equation ine midzi 1, 2, 3 se (x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=0, itambanudze, uye uwane a, b, c.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.1: Isa a, b, c dzawakawana mumutauro wesarudzo imwe neimwe uye uwane iyo inowirirana nehuwandu neproducts zvemidzi mitatu.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.b: Wakaverenga macoefficients sezvaakaita. Fananidza huwandu 6 nekukosha kwe a kana midzi mitatu i1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.c: Wakavhiringidza zviratidzo zvechipiri nechitatu nezviratidzo zveequadratics. Verenga makoshero e b ne c kana midzi i1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.d: Hauna kuchinja chiratidzo chehuwandu. Wana kukosha kwe a kana midzi i1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.explain: (x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=x³−6x²+11x−6, saka a=−6, b=11, c=−6. Huwandu 6=−a, huwandu hweproducts dzemidzi miviri 11=b, uye product 6=−c.

n-m-h1-eq-06.title: Kunyora patsva "hapana midzi kana D<0" kuti ienderane nevateereri
n-m-h1-eq-06.topic: Discriminant yequadratic equation: kusiyanisa "hapana real roots" ne "hapana midzi"
n-m-h1-eq-06.goal: Nyora patsva chirevo nezve discriminant zvakarurama kuvateereri (munin'ina wegiredhi 9, shamwari yekirasi), uye utsvage poinzi apo mashoko asingataure nhamba system anokonzera kusanzwisisana.
n-m-h1-eq-06.material: Gyumin akanyora mazwi akakosha nezve discriminant mubhuku kutsanangurira munin'ina wake, ari mugiredhi 9, midzi yequadratic equations. (a, b, c dziri real numbers uye a≠0.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.thinking.1: Nyora zvirimo zvakafanana nemashoko akasiyana kuti zvienderane nevateereri
n-m-h1-eq-06.thinking.2: Taura nhamba system kuti unyore zvakarurama
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mubhuku raGyumin usina kururama.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kuti mutsara wega wega unofungidzira nhamba system ipi.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tora equation ine D negative, seye x²+1=0, uye ufunge kana ichichaizvo isina mhinduro dzose.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.0: Kune quadratic equation ax²+bx+c=0, tinodaidza D=b²−4ac.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.1: Kana D>0, ine real roots mbiri dzakasiyana.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.3: Kana D=0, ine real double root.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 haurarurama. Kana D<0 hapana real roots, asi muhigh school nhamba dzinowedzerwa kuita complex numbers, uye equation ine imaginary roots mbiri dziri conjugates dzemumwe nemumwe. Mitsara 1, 2, ne4 yakarurama.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva mutsara 3 mumitsara imwe kana miviri kuti munin'ina wegiredhi 9 anzwisise. (Haasati adzidza imaginary numbers, asi anoziva magirafu.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti "hapana midzi" yakataurwa munhamba system ipi, wobva waisa range iyoyo mumutsara.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.1: Girai kuti midzi yeequation inoonekwa kupi pagirafu uye ubatanidze izvozvo nemutsara.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Panzvimbo yekunyora "hapana midzi" sezvayakaita, wakataura kuti unoreva nhamba system ipi here?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura uchishandisa pfungwa yemagirafu yaanoziva munin'ina wako here?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.0: Kana D<0, hapana midzi pakati pe real numbers. Girafu (parabola) haisangani ne x-axis. Kana tikawedzera kunhamba dzinonzi imaginary numbers, midzi inoonekwa, asi uchazvidzidza gare gare.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.1: Kana D<0, hapana real roots. Izvi zvinoreva kuti girafu ye y=ax²+bx+c haisangani ne x-axis. Muhigh school, kana nhamba dzawedzerwa, imwe mhando yemidzi inoonekwa.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, nyora patsva mutsara 3 mumashoko akarurama pachinyorwa chinoverengwa neshamwari yegiredhi 10. (Nyora huwandu nemhando yemidzi zvose.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.0: Mumutsara wemunin'ina wegiredhi 9, "zvaachadzidza zvinotevera" zvakasiiwa. Panguva ino, zvinyore zvakananga.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti pane imaginary roots dzingani uye kuti imaginary roots mbiri dzinobatana sei, uchishandisa mhinduro dze x²+1=0 sereferensi.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora kuti pane imaginary roots dzingani uye dzinobatana sei here?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Zvakasiyana neruzivo rwegiredhi 9, wakawedzera nhamba system kuita complex numbers here?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.0: Kana D<0, hapana real roots, uye pane imaginary roots mbiri dzakasiyana dziri conjugates dzemumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.1: Kana D<0, hapana real roots, asi mucomplex numbers pane imaginary roots 2. Midzi miviri icomplex conjugates dzemumwe nemumwe.

n-m-h1-eq-07.title: Kugadzira mapairi eexponent ane i^p+i^q=0
n-m-h1-eq-07.topic: Complex numbers: mapowers eimaginary unit i nemamiriro ehuwandu hwe0
n-m-h1-eq-07.goal: Shandisa pateni inodzokororwa mumapowers e i kugadzira mapairi eexponent ane huwandu hwe0 iwe pachako, uye pfupisa nemashoko zvinofanana mapairi iwayo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.material: Imaginary unit i inogutsa i²=−1. Kutora mapowers e i kunopa i, i²=−1, i³, i⁴, …, uye kana ukanyora makoshero nenzira, makoshero akafanana anodzokororwa. Funga i^p+i^q kune nhamba dzechisikwa p, q. (i^p inoreva i kumupowers wep.)
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.1: Gadzira mienzaniso inokodzera mamiriro iwe pachako
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.2: Ita generalization uye utsanangure zvinofanana mienzaniso yawakagadzira
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.prompt: Kukosha kwe i²⁰²⁵ (i kumupowers we2025) i chii?
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga i¹, i², i³, i⁴, i⁵, i⁶ nenzira uye unyore kuti makoshero anoenderera sei.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga exponent apo makoshero anotanga kudzokororwa, wobva wawana remainder kana 2025 yakapatsanurwa nenhamba iyoyo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.b: i²=−1 ndiko kukosha kana exponent iri 2. Tarisa kuti remainder i chii kana 2025 yakapatsanurwa ne4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.c: i³=−i kana remainder yeexponent yakapatsanurwa ne4 iri 3. Wana remainder kana 2025 yakapatsanurwa ne4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.d: i⁴=1 kana exponent iri multiple ye4. Tarisa remainder kana 2025 yakapatsanurwa ne4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.explain: i, −1, −i, 1 zvinodzokororwa mumapoka e4. Remainder kana 2025 yakapatsanurwa ne4 i1, saka i²⁰²⁵=i¹=i.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapairi matatu akasiyana (p, q) enhamba dzechisikwa (1≤p, q≤40) kuti i^p+i^q=0, uye uaise.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora makoshero e i¹ kusvika ku i⁸ uye utsvage mapairi emakoshero maviri ane huwandu hwe0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wawana pairi, edza kana kuwedzera maexponent ne4 kunopa makoshero akafanana, uye chinja maexponent kugadzira mapairi matsva.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p ne q dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzechisikwa kubva ku1 kusvika ku40.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.ok.c2: i^p ne i^q dzakapesana, saka huwandu i0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c2: i^p+i^q haisi 0. Nyora makoshero maviri zvakananga.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.explain: i¹+i³=i+(−i)=0, i²+i⁸=−1+1=0, i¹⁰+i⁴=−1+1=0. Kana remainder ye p−q yakapatsanurwa ne4 iri 2, makoshero maviri akapesana.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.prompt: Taura remainder kana p−q yakapatsanurwa ne4 kumapairi awakagadzira, uye utsanangure kuti nei i^p+i^q i0 ipapo, nekubvisa i^q segwaro rinowanzwa.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kumapairi matatu awakagadzira, wana p−q, nyora remainder yega yega pakupatsanura ne4, uye utsvage zvinofanana.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora i^p seproduct ye i^q ne i^(p−q), uye uwane kuti i^(p−q) ine kukosha kupi.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Sezvo remainder ye p−q yakapatsanurwa ne4 i ..., ...
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga p−q zvakananga kumapairi matatu awakagadzira here?
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti i^p inogona kunyorwa muchimiro i^q·i^(p−q) here?
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.model.0: Remainder ye p−q yakapatsanurwa ne4 i2. Mu i^p+i^q=i^q(i^(p−q)+1), i^(p−q) yakaenzana ne i²=−1, saka mukati mamabhurakiti i−1+1=0 uye huwandu i0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.model.1: Musiyano we p ne q unosiya remainder 2 kana wakapatsanurwa ne4. Ipapo i^p i i^q nguva i²=−1, saka ine chiratidzo chakapesana ne i^q, uye kuwedzera zvose zviri zviviri kunopa 0.

n-m-h1-eq-09.title: Kana hapana pakati pevanosarudzwa vemidzi yeinteger ari mudzi, hapana real root futi here?
n-m-h1-eq-09.topic: Maequations ane degree yakakwirira: kuongorora vanosarudzwa vemidzi yeinteger nekuvapo kwemidzi yereal
n-m-h1-eq-09.goal: Siyanisa zvinotaurwa nezvisingataurwe nemhedzisiro yekuongorora vanosarudzwa vose vemidzi yeinteger, uye uratidze kuti real root iripo uchishandisa shanduko yechiratidzo mumakoshero efunction.
n-m-h1-eq-09.material: Jiwon akaedza kugadzirisa equation f(x)=0 kune f(x)=x³−3x−1. Mudzi weinteger weequation ine integer coefficients ine leading coefficient 1 uri pakati pemadivisors eeconstant term −1. Jiwon akaisa vanosarudzwa 1, −1 uye akatarisa kuti f(1)=−3 ne f(−1)=1 dzose hadzisi 0, ndokupedzisa kuti "equation iyi haina real roots." Daeun akati, "Kana ukafunga nezvegirafu yecubic equation, mhedziso yaJiwon inoita seyinoshamisa."
n-m-h1-eq-09.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti nei real root iripo kunyange pasina integer root
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.0: Factor theorem nevanosarudzwa vemidzi yeinteger (madivisors eeconstant term)
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.1: Kuverenga makoshero efunction nechimiro chinoenderera chegirafu
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru kwekuongorora nemhedziso yaJiwon.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti mhedzisiro yekuongorora vanosarudzwa vemidzi yeinteger inotaura nezve mhando dzipi dzenhamba.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana kuongorora kune hwaro hwekubvisa kugoneka kwekuti imwe nhamba isiri integer inogutsa f(x)=0.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.a: Zvakarurama: kana hapana mumwe wevanosarudzwa ari mudzi, hapana real root futi
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.a: Wakatora midzi yeinteger nemidzi yereal seyakafanana. Funga kana dzimwe real numbers dzisiri integers dzingava midzi yeequation.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.b: Zvakaipa: kana vanosarudzwa ±1 vasiri midzi, zvinoreva kuti hapana integer root
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.c: Zvakaipa: kuverenga kwe f(1) ne f(−1) kwakaipa
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.c: f(1)=1−3−1=−3 ne f(−1)=−1+3−1=1, saka kuverenga kwakarurama. Tarisa kana dambudziko riri mumhedziso, kwete mukuverenga.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.d: Hazvigoni kuzivikanwa: factor theorem haigoni kushandiswa kucubic equation
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.d: Factor theorem inogona kushandiswa kumitauro yecubic futi. Nyaya ndeyekuti inotaura chii kana mumwe wevanosarudzwa asiri mudzi.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.explain: Kana vanosarudzwa vose vaongororwa, tinongogona kutaura kuti "hapana integer root." Pangava nereal root isiri integer, saka mhedziso ye "hapana real roots" haitsigirwi nekuongorora.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.prompt: Kune f(x)=x³−3x−1, tsvaga uye uise mapairi matatu akasiyana (m, n) kuti f(m)<0, f(n)>0, uye m ne n dziri integers dzinosiyana ne1 (−5≤m, n≤5).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga f(m) nenzira kune m kubva pa−5 kusvika ku5, uinyore mutebhura, uye ucherekedze zviratidzo chete.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.1: Mutebhura, tsvaga nzvimbo dzose apo celi yepositive iri padivi pecelle yenegative.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.ok.c1: m ne n integers dziri padhuze murange.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c1: m ne n dzinofanira kuva integers kubva pa−5 kusvika ku5 dzinosiyana ne1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c2: f(m) haisi negative. Verenga f(m) zvakananga.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c3: f(n) haisi positive. Verenga f(n) zvakananga.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.explain: f(−2)=−3, f(−1)=1, f(0)=−1, f(1)=−3, f(2)=1. Mapeya ari padyo apo chiratidzo chinochinja i (−2, −1), (0, −1), (1, 2).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.prompt: Nyora nei, kune (m, n) ne f(m) ne f(n) zvine zviratidzo zvakapesana, pane real root ye f(x)=0 pakati pazvo, uye nei real root iyoyo yakasiyana nema candidates akatariswa naJiwon.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.0: Dhonza graph uye ufunge kana, kana isingaputsiki ichienda kubva kudivi re negative kuenda kudivi re positive, inofanira kupfuura x-axis.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti root yawakawana iri pakati pe integers mbiri dzipi, uye uenzanise kana mutengo uyu ungaenzana ne ±1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvose kuti chiratidzo chemutengo we function chinochinja uye kuti graph yakabatanidzwa here?
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti real root yawakawana iri pakati pe integers saka haisi ma candidates ±1 here?
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.model.0: Graph ye y=f(x) yakabatanidzwa pasina kuputsika, saka kana f(m)<0 ne f(n)>0, inopfuura x-axis pakati pe m ne n. x papoinzi iyoyo i root. Root iyoyo i nhamba iri pakati pe m ne n, saka haisi integer, uye yakasiyana ne ma candidates 1, −1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.model.1: Sezvo graph ye f i continuous, mutengo unofanira kuva 0 mukati me interval apo unochinja kubva ku negative kuenda ku positive. Root iyi iri pakati pe integers mbiri dziri padyo, saka haisi integer, uye saka haigone kuwanikwa nekutarisa integer-root candidates.

n-m-h1-logic-06.title: Kunyora meseji yekutsanangura "necessary condition" kumunun'una
n-m-h1-logic-06.goal: Tsvaga kwakaipa mugadziriso yeshamwari nekuverenga direction ye necessary condition zvakapesana, uye unyore meseji inotsanangura direction nemuenzaniso wezuva nezuva, pasina zviratidzo.
n-m-h1-logic-06.material: Mutemo weraibhurari i "Pasina student ID, haugone kukweretwa mabhuku." Subin akashandisa mutemo uyu kuona kana "kuva ne student ID" i necessary condition ye "kugona kukweretwa mabhuku." p i "ane student ID" uye q i "anogona kukweretwa mabhuku."
n-m-h1-logic-06.thinking.2: Kunyora zvakare pasina zviratidzo kune munzwi akati
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa mubasa raSubin.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakare mutsetse mumwe nemumwe muchimiro che "Kana □, ipapo □," uchishandisa zviratidzo p ne q, uye uuenzanise nemutemo.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora mumutsara kuti ndechipi chiri mamiriro echipi kana tichiti "necessary condition."
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.0: Mutemo i 'Pasina student ID, haugone kukweretwa mabhuku.'
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.1: Wakanyorwa ne p ne q, mutemo uyu i ~p→~q.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.3: Sezvo q→p i chokwadi, p i necessary condition ye q.

n-m-h1-logic-05.title: Tinoda kuziva chii chimwe kana tichingoziva "Kana ichinaya, zvinoraswa"?
n-m-h1-logic-05.goal: Kana "kana p, saka q" ichokwadi, shanda kuti ndeupi ruzivo runodikanwa kuti upedze "kana q, saka p" zvechokwadi, uye utsanangure nekushandisa contrapositive kuti sei ruzivo urwu rwakakwana.
n-m-h1-logic-05.material: Mutemo wechikoro unoti, "Kana ichinaya, kirasi yekunze inoraswa," uye mutemo uyu unotevedzwa pasina kusiyana. Mina anoda kutaura, nguva dzose pasina kusiyana, mhedziso yokuti "Kana kirasi yekunze yakaraswa, saka zvaiva zuva ranaya." Mumutemo, p ndi "Inonaya" uye q ndi "Kirasi yekunze inoraswa."
n-m-h1-logic-05.thinking.1: Kunzwisisa kuti converse ne inverse zvinobatana sei
n-m-h1-logic-05.prereq.0: Converse, inverse, ne contrapositive yechirevo p→q
n-m-h1-logic-05.prereq.1: Contrapositive ine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chepakutanga
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza chokwadi, kunze kwemutemo, chinodikanwa kuti uve nechokwadi chemhedziso yaMina nguva dzose.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mhedziso yaunoda Mina kutaura muchimiro che "Kana □, saka □," uchishandisa p ne q.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora sarudzo imwe neimwe patsva muchimiro chimwe chete, wobva watonga kana ichitotevera kubva mumutemo kana ruzivo rutsva.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.a: Pamazuva apo kirasi yekunze inoitwa, haina kunaya
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.a: Chirevo ichi i contrapositive ye "Kana ichinaya, kirasi inosukwa." Chatotevera kubva pamutemo, saka hazvisi ruzivo rutsva.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.b: Mumwedzi wapfuura, zuva rega rega rakasukwa raiva zuva remvura
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.b: Kucherechedza kwenguva shoma dzekupedzisira hakuvimbise kuti zvichagara zvakadaro muneramangwana. Tinoda mutemo unogara uchishanda.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.d: Hapana mazuva emvura anopfuura gumi mumwedzi
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.d: Huwandu hwemazuva emvura hahuna hukama ne "Kana yasukwa, ipapo yainaya."
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.explain: Mhedziso yaMina i q→p (converse). "Kana isinganinayi, kirasi haisukwi" i ~p→~q (inverse), uye contrapositive yayo i q→p chaizvo. Saka kana inverse inogara ichishanda, converse inogara ichishandawo. Sarudzo a i contrapositive yemutemo wekutanga chete uye haipe ruzivo rutsva, uye b ne d dzinenge dzisiri mitemo inogara ichishanda kana kuti hadzina hukama.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.prompt: Uchishandisa chokwadi chawakasarudza, tsanangura mumitsara miviri kana mitatu kuti nei mhedziso yaMina inogara ichishanda. Shandisa izwi rekuti "contrapositive."
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora chokwadi chawakasarudza muchimiro che "Kana □, ipapo □," wobva wachinjanisa hypothesis ne conclusion uye wanyore negation yazvose zviri zviviri.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa mutsara waunogadzira nemhedziso yaMina kuti uone kana yakafanana.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Contrapositive ye "Kana isinganinayi, kirasi haisukwi" i ...
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora chokwadi chawakasarudza muchimiro ~p→~q, uchishandisa zviratidzo p ne q here?
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Paunogadzira contrapositive, wakachinja "~" pazvikamu zvose zviri zviviri here?
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataurawo kuti mutemo wekutanga oga hauvimbise mhedziso iyi here?
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.model.0: Contrapositive ye "Kana isinganinayi, kirasi haisukwi" i "Kana yasukwa, ipapo yainaya." Contrapositive inogara iine truth value imwechete nechirevo chekutanga, saka mhedziso yaMina inogara ichishanda.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.model.1: Chokwadi ichocho chinoreva kuti kana ~p, ipapo ~q, uye contrapositive yayo i: kana q, ipapo p, ndiko kuti, kana kirasi yasukwa, yaiva zuva remvura. Contrapositive ine truth value imwechete ne proposition yekutanga, saka mhedziso i chokwadi.

n-m-h1-logic-07.title: Kuwana nhamba mbiri dzine seti dzema multiples dzine union ine zvikamu 12
n-m-h1-logic-07.goal: Verenga zvikamu zve union yeseti dzema multiples enhamba mbiri nekuita inclusion-exclusion, uye shandisa chokwadi chekuti zvikamu zvinowanikwa pamwe chete i ma multiples e least common multiple kuwana nhamba mbiri dzinogutsa mamiriro.
n-m-h1-logic-07.material: Pakati pe natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 60, A ngaive seti yema multiples e a uye B seti yema multiples e b. Semuenzaniso, kana a=4, A={4, 8, 12, …, 60}.
n-m-h1-logic-07.thinking.0: Kunyora zvakare huwandu hwezvikamu ze union uchishandisa huwandu hwezvikamu ze intersection
n-m-h1-logic-07.thinking.2: Kuwana mhinduro dzakati wandei uye kuidzitarisa
n-m-h1-logic-07.prereq.1: Ma multiples, ma common multiples, ne least common multiple
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.prompt: Kana a=6 ne b=15, sarudza chirevo chinotsanangura zvakanyatsonaka zvikamu ze A∩B.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora iwe pachako nhamba shoma, kutanga neidiki, dzine ma multiples e 6 ne 15 zvose.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa nhamba dzawakawana uye utarise kuti dzinoumba ma multiples enhamba ipi.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.a: Ma multiples e 90, saka hapana kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 60
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.a: Yakatora product 6×15 sehwaro hwema common multiples. Haina kutarisa kana pane common multiple diki.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.b: Yakaenzana nediki pahuwandu hwema multiples e 6 nehuwandu hwema multiples e 15
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.b: Yakatora diki pahukuru hwemaseti maviri ema multiples sehukuru hwe intersection. Haina kuwana nhamba dzinopindirana zvakananga.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.c: Ma multiples e 30, saka kune mbiri: 30 ne 60
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.d: Yakashandisa 3, common divisor ye 6 ne 15, sehwaro. Kuva multiple ye 3 hakuiti kuti nhamba ive multiple ye 6 ne 15.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.explain: Nhamba dzinova ma multiples e 6 ne 15 zvose i ma multiples e least common multiple yadzo, 30. Kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 60, kune mbiri: 30 ne 60. Kana ukadziverenga sema multiples e 6×15=90, unowana pasina zvisizvo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapeya maviri akasiyana enatural numbers a, b kuti n(A∪B)=12. Mamiriro: 2≤a<b≤20, a ne b hadzisi coprime, uye b haisi multiple ye a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kune a imwe neimwe, tanga wawana n(A)=⌊60÷a⌋, wobva watarisa kana kuwedzera hukuru hwemaseti maviri nekubvisa kupindirana kunopa 12.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Wana kupindirana uchishandisa least common multiple. Sarudza dzimwe (a, b) dzinogoneka uye ugadzire tebhura yekuverenga kuti uenzanise.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b i natural numbers dzine 2≤a<b≤20.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Hadzisi coprime, uye b haisi multiple ye a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Hadzifaniri kuva coprime, uye b haifaniri kuva multiple ye a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.explain: (6, 15): 10+4−2=12, (6, 16): 10+3−1=12, (6, 20): 10+3−1=12, (8, 10): 7+6−1=12. Mumuganhu uyu, mapeya mana aya ndiwo chete. Kana ukaverenga kupindirana sema multiples e a×b, ipapo (6, 15) inopa 10+4−0=14, izvo zvisina kururama.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Kune (a, b)=(6, 15), tsanangura nei usingafaniri kuverenga zvikamu zvinowanikwa pamwe chete sema multiples e 6×15=90.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora ma multiples e 6 ne 15 kusvika ku 60 uye uwane nhamba dzavanogovana.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kana nhamba idzodzo dzishoma kana dzakakura kupfuura 90.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Ma common multiples e 6 ne 15 i ..., saka ...
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakawana least common multiple ye 6 ne 15 iwe pachako here?
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti 90 i imwe chete yema common multiples, kwete diki zvikuru here?
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Least common multiple ye 6 ne 15 i 30. Saka 30 ne 60 i ma multiples e zvose zviri zviviri zvakare, uye kana ukaverenga ma multiples e 90 chete, unosiya mbiri idzi uye unonganisa.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Nhamba iri multiple ye 6 ne 15 zvose i multiple ye least common multiple, 30. 90 i imwe chete pazvo, saka kana tikashandisa iyo chete, 30 ne 60 hadzisi kuverengwa sezvikamu zvinowanikwa pamwe chete.

n-m-h1-logic-08.title: Tinosarudza sei kana proposition ye "kune x yose" i yechokwadi kana yenhema?
n-m-h1-logic-08.goal: Sarudza kana proposition inotanga ne "kune x yose" i yechokwadi kana yenhema uchishandisa counterexample imwe chete kana nharo yose, kwete mitengo mishoma; nyora negation yayo zvakarurama; uye funga mitengo yemuganhu.
n-m-h1-logic-08.material:
Proposition P: "Kune real numbers x dzose, x²−4x+k>0." (k i constant) Shamwari nhatu dzakasarudza kana P i yechokwadi kana yenhema kana k=4, seizvi.
- Jiho: Ndakaisa x=0, 1, 3, 5 uye mitengo yose yaiva yakakura kupfuura 0, saka i yechokwadi.
- Seoyeon: x²−4x+4=(x−2)², uye square i 0 kana kupfuura, saka inogara i yakakura kupfuura 0. I yechokwadi.
- Daeun: Kana ndikaisa x=2, mutengo i 0, iyo isiri yakakura kupfuura 0. I yenhema.
n-m-h1-logic-08.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa mitengo mishoma yawakatarisa nemitengo yose
n-m-h1-logic-08.prereq.1: Perfect square expressions ne minimum ye quadratic
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.prompt: Kana k=4, sarudza truth value yakarurama ye P pamwe chete nechikonzero chayo chakarurama.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.0: Siyanisa kana kufunga kweshamwari imwe neimwe "kwakatarisa mitengo mishoma" kana "kwakafukidza mitengo yose."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.1: Wana mutengo mudiki zvikuru we expression yakanyorwa naSeoyeon, uye uuenzanise ne "yakakura kupfuura 0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.a: Chokwadi: nekuti yakashanda kune mitengo yose mishoma yandakaedza
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.a: Yakatsiva "real numbers dzose" nemitengo mishoma yakatariswa. Kuchine mitengo isina kutariswa yakasara.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.b: Chokwadi: square inogara i 0 kana kupfuura, saka mutengo we expression i wakakura kupfuura 0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.b: Yakachinja "0 kana kupfuura" kuita "yakakura kupfuura 0." Yakasiya mamiriro apo kuenzana kunoitika.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.c: Nhema: kune real number iyo expression yakaenzana ne 0 nayo, izvo zvinoputsa "yakakura kupfuura 0 kune real numbers dzose"
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.d: Hazvizikanwi: kune real numbers dzisingaperi, saka hazvigoneki kuidzitarisa dzose
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.d: Yakafungidzira kuti unogona kusarudza nekutarisa mitengo rimwe panguva imwe chete. Unogona kusarudza uchishandisa counterexample imwe chete kana chimiro che expression.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.explain: Proposition yechimiro "kune real numbers x dzose" i yenhema kana x imwe chete (counterexample) ikakundikana. Kana k=4, expression i (x−2)², uye pa x=2 i 0, saka "yakakura kupfuura 0" haishande; saka P i yenhema. Nzira yaJiho i mitengo mishoma yakatariswa chete, uye Seoyeon akanganisa "0 kana kupfuura" ne "yakakura kupfuura 0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti mitengo ye x mingani inofanira kukundikana kuti "kune yose …, …" ive yenhema.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti negation ye inequality ">" i chii, uye kuti mamiriro e kuenzana ne 0 anoenda kudivi ripi.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.a: Kune real numbers x dzose, x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.a: Yakachengeta "kune yose" sezvayakaita, uye yakanyorawo negation ye ">" se "<" chete. Zvikamu zvose zviri zviviri hazvina kururama.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.b: Kune real numbers x dzose, x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.b: Yakachengeta "kune yose" seyakanga iri negation ye "kune yose" uye yakachinja chete chiratidzo che inequality mushure meizvozvo. Yakasiya kuti chirevo chinova chenhema kana mamiriro imwe chete akakundikana.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.c: Kune real number x kuti x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.c: Yakanyora negation ye ">" se "<" chete. Mamiriro apo mutengo i 0 anoshaikwa.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.d: Kune real number x kuti x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.explain: Negation ye "kune x yose, A" i "kune x kuti kwete A." Negation ye ">0" i "≤0" (0 kana pasi), saka negation i: kune real number x kuti x²−4x+k≤0. Kana k=4, negation iyi i yechokwadi pa x=2, izvo zvinoenderana nekutonga kwekuti P i yenhema.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.prompt: Nyora renji yemitengo ye k apo P i yechokwadi, uye utsanangure mumutsara mumwe nei k=4 isiri mukati merenji iyoyo.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvakare x²−4x+k muchimiro chinoratidza (x−2)², uye uratidze mutengo mudiki seunoenderana ne k.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa nemamiriro e ">0" kusarudza kana mutengo mudiki iwoyo unofanira kuva wakakura kupfuura 0 kana 0 kana kupfuura chete.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Renji ye k i ..., uye kana k=4, ipapo x=...
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakare expression se (x−2)²+k−4 uye wakawana mutengo mudiki here?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakasarudza renji uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti mutengo mudiki unofanira kuva wakakura kupfuura 0 here?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaratidza nemutengo we x kuti nei ">" ichikundikana pamutengo wemuganhu here?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.0: x²−4x+k=(x−2)²+k−4 uye mudiki i k−4, saka inogara i yakakura kupfuura 0 kana k>4. Kana k=4, mutengo i 0 pa x=2, saka haisi yakakura kupfuura 0 uye k=4 haina kusanganisirwa.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.1: Discriminant 16−4k inofanira kuva negative, saka k inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 4. Kana k=4, discriminant i 0, saka mutengo we expression i 0 pa x=2, uye P i yenhema.
